item.title: CAAS Staff Accountant at Boulay
item.description:
We are currently seeking a talented Staff Accountant to join our Client Accounting and Advisory Services (CAAS) department!

Boulay offers accounting and consulting services, integrating business and owner strategies that help clients understand their impact on future success. Our advice comes from a strong focus on serving privately held owner-managed organizations, from start-ups to established small and mid-size businesses. Our team specializes in helping to improve day-to-day operations by offering outsourced accounting services, including bookkeeping, controller, and CFO services.

The CAAS Staff Accountant is responsible for assisting our clients with their internal accounting needs by performing and reviewing a variety of diversified accounting tasks. This includes working with multiple clients to help process their accounts payable, accounts receivable, processing or assisting to process payroll under the review of the engagement leader and owner. Tasks may include working primarily independently at times and assisting the client with questions that arise day to day with the accounting department. The role also involves working cross-functionally with other Boulay departments to effectively accomplish projects and initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity to gain experience across a diverse client base and a variety of industries while working with modern accounting technologies and growing into more advanced client responsibilities over time.

Client-Facing and Technical Work:

  • Manage the daily transaction accounting activities, including but not limited to:

    • Daily Sales, bank, and other account reconciliations
    • Inventory management
    • Accrual management
    • Prepaid management
    • Equity accounting management
    • Accounts receivables and accounts payable management
    • Management of critical client deadlines
    • Payroll process and preparation
    • Expense reimbursements

  • Discuss and explain transactions/processes with clients in a group or one-on-one setting as needed

  • Identify and recognize potential risks, concerns, or issues regarding the client file

  • Maintain accounting records through data entry and file management

  • Assist with preparing complex sales and use tax returns

  • Maintain a chart of accounts

  • Monitor and maintain fixed assets

  • Assist with preparing and reviewing 1099 filings

  • Assist preparing financial statements

  • Identify issues and communicate status updates with appropriate team member or Partner as necessary

  • Maintain professional and appropriate conduct; represent Firm and self well in all work-related situations

  • Follow all regulations and ethical standards set forth by the Firm and other governing bodies

  • Develop an understanding of the client’s business practices

  • Associate’s Degree in Accounting or Finance or related field

  • 2+ years of related professional experience

  • Strong computer skills and proficiency in various accounting and other software, including Microsoft Office Suite

  • Strong knowledge of all areas of the general ledger, along with reconciliations and month-end / year-end close procedures

  • Knowledge of GAAP

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills along with the ability to drive client and team meetings

  • Ability to creatively solve problems and analyze client data

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively

Preferred: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online and/or other general ledger software

The annual salary range for this position is: $60,000-77,000. This salary range reflects the anticipated responsibilities and qualifications of a successful candidate for this role. Final compensation may vary depending upon an individual’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Individuals may be eligible for additional compensation in the form of incentives, commissions, profit sharing, and more, depending on the role. Boulay offers a wide range of benefits such as medical, dental, vision, 401k, flexible schedules, hybrid (or remote, as applicable) work environment, paid time away, and more.

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible schedule
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Vision insurance
  • Work from home

item.title: Sales Development Representative - Remote at OnBoard
item.description:
Title:   Sales Development Representative

Function: Sales

Reports to: Director, Sales Development

Location: Australia - Remote

 

Position Summary:

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be responsible for developing demand for the company’s products and solutions. In this role, you will establish relationships with prospective customers to create a viable sales pipeline through marketing lead generation campaigns and direct outreach. You will play an integral part in conveying the value of the platform to potential clients, directly impacting the company’s future success. Additionally, this role offers opportunities for growth and professional development both within and beyond the department.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead Qualification: Identify, engage, and qualify leads from various marketing channels (e.g., website, conferences, etc.) and ensure they align with the company’s solutions.

  • Conduct direct outreach to engage new leads while prospecting into a technical audience, applying a deep understanding of the B2B sales cycle, and effectively handling objections.
  • Analyze lead generation trends and optimize outreach efforts based on feedback and performance metrics.
  • Utilize phone, email, and social selling techniques to connect with key decision-makers, delivering compelling value propositions tailored to their needs.

Sales & Marketing Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between marketing and sales, actively engaging in marketing campaigns, analyzing trends, and collaborating with Account Executives to nurture key prospects and facilitate a seamless transition from prospecting to closing.

Quota Achievement: Engage new leads through direct outreach while developing a broader understanding of the B2B sales cycle, including prospecting into a technical audience and handling objections. Required to consistently meet or exceed assigned quotas for Booked Meetings and Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) contributing to overall revenue growth.

Pipeline & Performance Tracking: Consistently track and report key sales development metrics, including conversion rates, meeting attendance, and engagement trends.

Tools & Technology Usage:  Use a variety of sales tools (SalesForce, etc.) to maintain and record detailed and accurate records of customer interactions and pipeline.

Gain experience in a fast-paced culture with corporate exposure while contributing to marketing strategies and developing professionally. Proactively seeks knowledge and stays informed about industry trends and innovations.

Skills & Experience Needed:

  • Bachelor’s Degree Required
  • Minimum 1+ years of proven sales development experience (exceeding quota) or customer-facing role engaging prospects while demonstrating strong communication, adaptability, and professionalism.
  • Minimum 1+ years working within a CRM system (Salesforce experience preferred).
  • Must be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident currently based in Australia and willing to continue to work in Australia remotely
  • Develop and deliver compelling outreach through strong communication skills, while confidently speaking in front of an audience and handling objections effectively.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities, with a disciplined approach to prospecting and follow-ups.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while maintaining a high level of self-motivation and discipline.
  • Comfortable speaking in front of an audience, whether in team meetings, client presentations, or sales pitches.
  • Demonstrate a growth mindset, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning, with a willingness to learn and be coached.

Competencies:

Accountability

Adaptability

Applied Learning

Business Acumen

Collaboration

Customer Focus

Dealing w/Ambiguity

Decision Making

Driving for Results

Initiating Action

Planning and Organizing

Technical/Professional Knowledge/Skills

 

About the Company:

Boards set the standard for what organizations can achieve. At OnBoard, our board management software helps boards function at a higher level so every organization can make a bigger difference in the world.

Launched in 2011, today, OnBoard serves as the board intelligence platform for more than 5,000 organizations and their 12,000 boards and committees in 60 countries worldwide. With customers in higher education, nonprofit, healthcare systems, government, and enterprise business, OnBoard is the leading board management provider.

OnBoard has grown from a class project at Purdue University in West Lafayette, Indiana in 2003 into the world’s leading board management software platform today. Backed by JMI Equity and the acquisitions of eScribe and Govenda, OnBoard is positioned to become the industry leader in Board Management and Meeting Solutions for private and public sector entities.

Benefits and Perks: 

  • Fully remote work with company provided equipment (laptop, software, etc.)

  • Employment with a growing, casual, fun, philanthropic minded company

  • US Based Employees

    • Comprehensive, high-quality medical/prescription drug plan options, as well as dental and vision plan offerings.
    • An employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA) if you participate in a High Deductible Healthcare Plan.
    • Medical Flexible Spending Accounts available.
    • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts available.
    • Basic life insurance in the amount of $50,000 or 1 X’s your salary (whichever is higher).
    • Short and long-term disability and Accidental Death and Dismemberment benefits at no cost to you.
    • 401K Retirement Savings Plan with automatic enrollment at the first of the month following 60 days of employment at 5% to help you secure your financial freedom. We offer a generous company match that starts on the first of the month following 60 days of employment. The company match is dollar for dollar on the first 3% of your pay that you contribute and $0.50 on the dollar on the next 2%, for a total match of 4%.
    • Paid Time Off (PTO)/Holiday

  • CAN Based Employees

    • Employer paid Life and Accidental Death Insurance
    • Contribution to Health Care Spending Account
    • Dependent Life Insurance
    • Optional Life Insurance
    • LTD Insurance
    • Drug and Paramedical Coverage
    • Dental Insurance
    • Vision Insurance
    • EAP

  • AUS Based employees

    • Superannuation rate of 12%
    • Monthly stipend of $400 AUD to purchase private medical insurance

  • UK Based Employees (via EPG)

    • Pension - Aegon

      • Passageways/OnBoard contributes 8% of the employee’s basic salary
      • Employees can contribute up to 100% of salary subject to max limits
      • Enrolled from Day 1 of employment

    • Private Medical Insurance

    • Life Assurance

    • Income Protection

    • Critical Illness

    • Employee Assistance Programme

    • Serious Illness Benefit

    • Help@Hand

    • Cashplan

Diversity Statement - Culture of Togetherness:  

At OnBoard, our mission is to encourage and celebrate a culture of togetherness. We acknowledge that uniqueness is powerful, and we welcome, foster, and appreciate all. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusiveness fuel the Pathfinder atmosphere and all our efforts. Our power is in our people and we Pledge 1% to give back to our communities and across the globe.

OnBoard is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment. We  do not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Interview Transparency & Technology Disclosure
We use video/audio recordings and artificial intelligence (AI) tools during our interview process to transcribe responses, evaluate skills, and streamline evaluations. Your data is processed securely and handled in line with our Privacy Policy and local data protection laws

item.title: Senior Proposal Consultant at Ramboll
item.description:
Company Description

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Job Description

We invite you to bring your strategic mindset into play as you help Ramboll Americas develop and win new business.

Are you an experienced proposal professional who enjoys bringing structure to fast moving opportunities and getting things done? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where you work across technical disciplines and business areas to help teams deliver high quality, client focused work? Are you energized by balancing multiple priorities, solving problems, and helping colleagues find a path forward?

If this sounds interesting to you, or you are curious to learn more, this role could be the right opportunity for you. Join our Clients & Sales team as our new Senior Proposal Consultant and help Ramboll develop and deliver compelling proposals and qualifications across the Americas.

All US based locations considered.  We have one remote or hybrid position in the United States. Please see our map for local offices https://ramboll.com/worldwide.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Your new role

As our new Senior Proposal Consultant, you will independently manage fast moving proposals, qualifications, and sales support requests across Ramboll’s business areas in the Americas, from initial need through completion. You will work closely with business development colleagues, technical experts, market leaders, proposal professionals, and leadership to coordinate multidisciplinary responses, develop compelling client focused materials, and support opportunities across the business, with Data Centers as a primary area of focus. This is a hands-on role for someone who can quickly bring structure to competing priorities, identify practical solutions, and drive high-quality work to completion within tight timelines.

Your key responsibilities will be:

  • Proposal Management. Independently manage proposals, qualifications, presentations, questionnaires, interview materials, and other pursuit deliverables from initial request through final submission, ensuring compliance, accuracy, quality, and timely delivery while managing competing deadlines.
  • Coordination and Collaboration. Lead proposal kick-offs, progress meetings, content reviews, and final production, coordinating contributors, clarifying requirements, resolving gaps, and keeping multiple deliverables moving to meet deadlines.
  • Content Development and Sales Support. Provide responsive sales and pursuit support across Ramboll’s business areas, developing client focused materials that clearly communicate Ramboll’s experience, capabilities, differentiators, and value. Support opportunity and client engagement needs through presentations, client meeting materials, tailored qualifications, and other sales content.
  • Systems and Proposal Resources. Actively update, promote, and improve Ramboll systems and processes that interface with the internal client experience, including client relationship management software, the internal resume and project database, and the standard marketing content library. Work with team members to develop and maintain resumes, project descriptions, standard content, templates, and other reusable proposal and marketing materials. Use approved AI enabled tools to support proposal planning, drafting, editing, research, and quality control, while applying appropriate professional judgement and following Ramboll requirements.
  • Pursuit and Team Support. Serve as a responsive, solutions-oriented resource to colleagues and contribute broader pursuit support when needed, including capture planning, positioning, research, debriefs, and other pursuit activities. Share knowledge, resources, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen proposal delivery and support others in the development of their proposal capabilities.

Your new team

As part of the team, you will be part of Ramboll’s Americas Clients & Sales team, which brings together specialized expertise, tools, systems, and resources to help the business develop clients, pursue opportunities, and win work.

Our team is focused on building strong, consistent ways of working that make it easier for colleagues to access the expertise, resources, and support they need. We value sharing knowledge, learning from one another, and continually improving our tools and practices while creating opportunities for professional growth and connection with the broader industry.

Qualifications

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. While we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

These include:

  • Education and Experience. Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, English, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, with 7 or more years of experience in proposals, pursuits, marketing, or a related professional services environment.
  • Proposal Leadership. Demonstrated ability to independently manage proposals and qualifications in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry, technical consulting, or a similar professional services environment, while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Writing and Communication. Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and communication skills, with the ability to develop clear, compelling, and client focused content from technical and nontechnical information and work effectively across organisational levels and technical disciplines.
  • Tools and Systems. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite as a bonus, SharePoint, Power BI, and CRM.
  • CRM & Research Acumen: Experience maintaining accurate pursuit and client data and using CRM and targeted market or client research to inform positioning, tracking, and post-pursuit insights.
  • Project and Stakeholder Management. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate diverse contributors, work effectively in a fast moving environment, and drive work to completion without direct authority.

Additional Information

What we can offer you

  • Meaningful, high-impact work
  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Professional development and leadership opportunities
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $82,000 to $110,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at [email protected] with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

As part of our hiring process, Ramboll may conduct pre-employment drug screenings for applicable roles to ensure a safe and compliant workplace.  You may be subject to random drug testing in accordance with client requirements.

  • Education and Experience. Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, English, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, with 7 or more years of experience in proposals, pursuits, marketing, or a related professional services environment.
  • Proposal Leadership. Demonstrated ability to independently manage proposals and qualifications in the architecture, engineering, and construction industry, technical consulting, or a similar professional services environment, while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Writing and Communication. Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and communication skills, with the ability to develop clear, compelling, and client focused content from technical and nontechnical information and work effectively across organisational levels and technical disciplines.
  • Tools and Systems. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite as a bonus, SharePoint, Power BI, and CRM.
  • CRM & Research Acumen: Experience maintaining accurate pursuit and client data and using CRM and targeted market or client research to inform positioning, tracking, and post-pursuit insights.
  • Project and Stakeholder Management. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate diverse contributors, work effectively in a fast moving environment, and drive work to completion without direct authority.

Additional Information

What we can offer you

  • Meaningful, high-impact work
  • Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Professional development and leadership opportunities
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $82,000 to $110,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at [email protected] with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

As part of our hiring process, Ramboll may conduct pre-employment drug screenings for applicable roles to ensure a safe and compliant workplace.  You may be subject to random drug testing in accordance with client requirements.

item.title: Account Executive, eScribe at OnBoard
item.description:
Account Executive 

Function: Sales 

Reports to:  Director, Sales 

Location: Remote, Texas, United States 

Position Summary: 

The Account Executive will lead and execute the complete sales lifecycle—from prospecting through contract closure—focused on local governments, including municipalities and City Clerk offices for our eScribe product, here at OnBoard. This role is instrumental in expanding adoption of our industry-leading, cloud-based meeting management software. The ideal candidate will act as a trusted advisor, helping public sector organizations streamline operations and improve transparency. Success in this role requires a combination of strategic thinking, strong relationship-building skills, a consultative sales approach, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

  • Full-Cycle Sales Ownership: Drive the end-to-end sales process, including lead generation, discovery, presentations, negotiation, and closing new business.

  • Prospecting and Outreach: Proactively identify, qualify, and engage high-value prospects through cold calling, industry networking, events, trade shows, inbound lead follow-up, and other outreach methods.

  • Client Engagement: Deliver compelling, needs-based presentations and demonstrations—virtually or in-person—tailored to the workflows and challenges of local government clients.

  • Pipeline Management: Maintain a robust sales pipeline using a consultative methodology. Leverage your understanding of buying committees and decision-makers to accelerate deals and align with client timelines.

  • Data Integrity and Forecasting: Utilize CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) to meticulously track activities, maintain data hygiene, and produce accurate sales forecasts and reports.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Customer Success to ensure seamless onboarding and long-term retention of new clients. Partner with Product and Marketing to relay client insights that inform roadmap and campaign development.

  • Thought Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert and industry advocate by staying informed about trends in government technology and meeting management.

  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate ongoing relationships to support upsell opportunities, referrals, and renewals through continuous engagement and support.

  • Engage with the Product and Marketing teams to validate product strategy and serve as a thought partner based on your discovery in customer conversations.

Skills and Experience Needed: 

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 4+ years of demonstrated success in B2B software sales or enterprise lead generation with consistent quota attainment.
  • 1+ years of experience selling into local governments, municipalities, or to City Clerk offices—strong understanding of their processes and procurement cycles is essential.
  • Preferred: Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience with artificial intelligence tools and concepts (such as machine learning, NLP, or automation)
  • High level of resilience, self-motivation, and a proven track record of working independently to exceed goals.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills—both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with online presentation platforms (e.g., Zoom, MS Teams).
  • Experience with Salesforce or other leading CRM platforms required.
  • Knowledge of formal sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, SPIN Selling, Challenger) is a plus.

Competencies: 

  • Accountability
  • Adaptability
  • AI Curiosity & Innovation
  • Applied Learning
  • Business Acumen
  • Collaboration
  • Customer Focus
  • Dealing w/Ambiguity
  • Decision Making
  • Driving for Results
  • Initiating Action
  • Planning and Organizing
  • Technical/Professional Knowledge/Skills

About the Company:

Boards set the standard for what organizations can achieve. At OnBoard, our board management software helps boards function at a higher level so every organization can make a bigger difference in the world.

Launched in 2011, today, OnBoard serves as the board intelligence platform for more than 5,000 organizations and their 12,000 boards and committees in 60 countries worldwide. With customers in higher education, nonprofit, healthcare systems, government, and enterprise business, OnBoard is the leading board management provider.

OnBoard has grown from a class project at Purdue University in West Lafayette, Indiana in 2003 into the world’s leading board management software platform today. Backed by JMI Equity and the acquisitions of eScribe and Govenda, OnBoard is positioned to become the industry leader in Board Management and Meeting Solutions for private and public sector entities.

Benefits and Perks: 

  • Fully remote work with company provided equipment (laptop, software, etc.)

  • Employment with a growing, casual, fun, philanthropic minded company

  • US Based Employees

    • Comprehensive, high-quality medical/prescription drug plan options, as well as dental and vision plan offerings.
    • An employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA) if you participate in a High Deductible Healthcare Plan.
    • Medical Flexible Spending Accounts available.
    • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts available.
    • Basic life insurance in the amount of $50,000 or 1 X’s your salary (whichever is higher).
    • Short and long-term disability and Accidental Death and Dismemberment benefits at no cost to you.
    • 401K Retirement Savings Plan with automatic enrollment at the first of the month following 60 days of employment at 5% to help you secure your financial freedom. We offer a generous company match that starts on the first of the month following 60 days of employment. The company match is dollar for dollar on the first 3% of your pay that you contribute and $0.50 on the dollar on the next 2%, for a total match of 4%.
    • Paid Time Off (PTO)/Holiday

  • CAN Based Employees

    • Employer paid Life and Accidental Death Insurance
    • Contribution to Health Care Spending Account
    • Dependent Life Insurance
    • Optional Life Insurance
    • LTD Insurance
    • Drug and Paramedical Coverage
    • Dental Insurance
    • Vision Insurance
    • EAP

  • AUS Based employees

    • Superannuation rate of 12%
    • Monthly stipend of $400 AUD to purchase private medical insurance

  • UK Based Employees (via EPG)

    • Pension - Aegon

      • Passageways/OnBoard contributes 8% of the employee’s basic salary
      • Employees can contribute up to 100% of salary subject to max limits
      • Enrolled from Day 1 of employment

    • Private Medical Insurance

    • Life Assurance

    • Income Protection

    • Critical Illness

    • Employee Assistance Programme

    • Serious Illness Benefit

    • Help@Hand

    • Cashplan

Diversity Statement - Culture of Togetherness:  

At OnBoard, our mission is to encourage and celebrate a culture of togetherness. We acknowledge that uniqueness is powerful, and we welcome, foster, and appreciate all. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusiveness fuel the Pathfinder atmosphere and all our efforts. Our power is in our people and we Pledge 1% to give back to our communities and across the globe.

OnBoard is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment. We  do not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Interview Transparency & Technology Disclosure
We use video/audio recordings and artificial intelligence (AI) tools during our interview process to transcribe responses, evaluate skills, and streamline evaluations. Your data is processed securely and handled in line with our Privacy Policy and local data protection laws

item.title: Senior AI Solution Developer - ERP (f/m/div.) at Bosch
item.description:
Company Description

The Bosch Group has more than 400 000 employees around the world, present in 60 countries, and we are proud to impact people’s lives and to work towards a more sustainable future.

In the city of Aveiro, Bosch has one of its biggest production sites for Bosch Home Comfort division, as well as a Research and Development Center for new and improved heating solutions for the residential segment. With more than 1400 employees, focused on innovation, sustainability and collaboration, Bosch Aveiro joins together experts in diverse areas, from mechanical engineering to connectivity and software solutions, as well as industrialization and quality.  

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference in mindsets, cultures, generations, identities and perspectives. Everyone should bring their authenticity and work together respectfully. Bosch is an employer that values diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process and in the performance of professional activity. By including everyone and ensuring equal opportunities we unleash our full potential.

Job Description

Your contribution to something big:

  • Develop AI solutions end to end: Design, prototype, implement, deploy and continuously improve Generative AI products and agentic workflows throughout their technical lifecycle.
  • Build hands-on AI solutions: Develop prompts, agent workflows and tool integrations using Python, enterprise AI platforms and workflow automation tools such as n8n.
  • Shape robust interfaces: Define clear technical interface requirements for SAP platform teams, including OData, BAPIs, RFCs, REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Translate business needs into technology: Work closely with AI Specialists, Data Engineers, ERP experts and business stakeholders to translate use cases and user feedback into effective AI solutions and technical requirements.
  • Prototype and experiment: Rapidly turn ideas into working prototypes, evaluate emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to bring them into production.
  • Drive product value: Co-own the lifecycle of AI products after rollout, including backlog prioritization, release coordination, continuous improvement and scaling across business areas and geographies.
  • Enable measurable impact: Focus on solutions that improve business processes, user experience and operational efficiency while ensuring scalability and maintainability.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you: 

Education: Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration or a comparable field.

Experience:

  • Several years of hands-on experience developing and deploying Generative AI and/or agentic AI solutions.
  • Experience with SAP ERP integration, ideally SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.

Know-how:

  • Strong knowledge of Python, LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, APIs and enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience with SAP integration technologies, including RFCs, BAPIs, OData, REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with Databricks, workflow automation or MCP is a plus.
  • Understanding of sales, CRM, pricing or customer intelligence processes is advantageous.

Working Style and Methods:

  • Hands-on, structured and solution-oriented approach.
  • Ability to prototype quickly and turn ideas into scalable solutions.
  • Enjoy working across AI, SAP and business teams.

Personality:

  • Curious, collaborative and proactive.
  • Strong ownership and motivation to turn AI innovation into business value.

Languages: Very good English skills.

Additional Information

Work #LikeABosch includes: 

⚖️ Flexible work conditions

🔀 Hybrid work system

🌐 Exchange with colleagues around the world

🧑‍⚕️ Health insurance and medical office on site (general surgeon, psychology, physiotherapy, general clinic)

📚 Training opportunities (p.e., technical training, foreign languages training) & certifications

📈 Opportunities for career progression and continuous professional development

💲 Access to great discounts in partnerships and Bosch products

🏋️ Sports and health related activities

💰 Flexible benefits platform

🅿️ Free parking lot

🍽️ Canteen

 

Success stories don´t just happen. They are made…

Make it happen! We are looking forward to your application!

item.title: Android Developer at Airalo
item.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we’re making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world’s first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we’re a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We’ve grown quickly, but we’ve worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We’re fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.

  • Contract:

    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent

  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74

  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you’ll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it’s actually like to work at Airalo? We’ve put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

You are someone who cares deeply about the quality of your work, the people who use it, and the team you build it with.

You take ownership of what you ship, from understanding why it matters to how it behaves once it’s in people’s hands, and you care whether it made a difference. You enjoy working closely with product managers, designers, QA and backend engineers: you ask questions early, share your ideas, and keep people in the loop so no one has to wonder where things stand.

You learn quickly, welcome feedback, and share what you learn with others. You use AI-assisted development with judgment, checking what it produces before you rely on it.

 

We are looking for an Android engineer to join the team building the Airalo app. You’ll own features from idea to production with your product team, and grow your craft alongside the engineers in our Mobile guild.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own features end to end: shape them with Product and Design, build, test and release them, and follow how they perform with users
  • Own the quality of your work in production: monitor stability and performance, investigate crashes and ANRs, and fix root causes
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and build within the team’s agreed patterns, proposing improvements when you see a better way
  • Keep quality high through meaningful tests and thoughtful code reviews
  • Plan and estimate your work, share progress proactively, and flag early when plans change
  • Take part in product experiments and use what they show to improve the app

What You’ll Bring:

  • 4+ years of Android development in Kotlin, with production experience in Jetpack Compose
  • Solid engineering fundamentals: clean, readable code, data structures and algorithms, design principles and testing
  • Solid Android fundamentals: app lifecycle, concurrency, memory, performance and debugging
  • Experience shipping and evolving apps at product companies, in cross-functional teams
  • Ownership of your work: you organise it, get yourself unblocked through research, your team or the guild, and deliver what you commit to
  • Hands-on AI-assisted development on real work: you validate what AI produces and understand the code you ship
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience improving app stability and startup performance, including ANRs
  • Experience with in-app payments or checkout flows
  • Experience making apps reliable on poor or unstable connections
  • Experience with Compose UI testing
  • Experience building localized apps

£74,800 - £112,200 a year

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍

📍 UK: £74,800 – £112,200

Your Home Destination: 🛫 Specific salary ranges used in offers are determined by where you reside. We’re committed to discussing these ranges openly during your first call with our Talent to ensure we’re aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link.

Why People Join Us

🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it’s the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There’s trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you’re responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy 

 

We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

At Airalo, we use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed using tools that help our recruiters analyze and organize CV information. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment; all hiring decisions are made by humans. If you progress to an interview, we may use tools to generate AI-assisted notes -  you can opt out of these. For more information on how we handle your data, please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy.

item.title: Development and Test Engineer for Hydraulics in Heat Pump development (f/m/div.) at Bosch
item.description:
Company Description

The Bosch Group has more than 400 000 employees around the world, present in 60 countries, and we are proud to impact people’s lives and to work towards a more sustainable future.

In the city of Aveiro, Bosch has one of its biggest production sites for Bosch Home Comfort division, as well as a Research and Development Center for new and improved heating solutions for the residential segment. With more than 1400 employees, focused on innovation, sustainability and collaboration, Bosch Aveiro joins together experts in diverse areas, from mechanical engineering to connectivity and software solutions, as well as industrialization and quality.  

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference in mindsets, cultures, generations, identities and perspectives. Everyone should bring their authenticity and work together respectfully. Bosch is an employer that values diversity and equal opportunities. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process and in the performance of professional activity. By including everyone and ensuring equal opportunities we unleash our full potential.

Job Description

Your contribution to something big:

As a Development and Test Engineer for Hydraulics in Heat Pump development, you will be at the heart of our green-tech innovation. You won’t just run tests, you will design the sustainable heating solutions of tomorrow.

  • Pioneer Hydraulic Systems: Lead the development, virtual modeling, and physical testing of cutting-edge hydraulic and heat pump systems.
  • Bridge the Physical & Virtual Worlds: Create robust simulation models (using Matlab/Simulink) to virtually test thermal components, accelerating our time-to-market.
  • Own the Validation Lifecycle: Design comprehensive test plans, build experimental setups, execute physical laboratory testing, and analyze complex psychrometric and thermodynamic operational data.
  • Spearhead Documentation & Quality: Author and review clear technical specifications and system documentation, translating customer and safety requirements into solid technical concepts.
  • Drive Efficiency: Collaborate on cost-reduction initiatives for existing appliance platforms through smart component selection and design improvements.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you: 

Education

  • Master of Science or Engineering Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, HVAC Technology, Thermal Power Engineering, or an equivalent field of study.

Experience & Know-how

  • Solid theoretical background in fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, psychrometry, and refrigeration cycles.
  • Practical experience with system simulation tools (such as Matlab Simulink) and testing management workflows (e.g., Atlassian XRay)

item.title: Data Engineer gyakornok at Bosch
item.description:
Cég leírása

Szeretnél ötleteiddel hasznos technológiák fejlesztéséhez hozzájárulni? Legyen szó mobilitási megoldásokról, fogyasztói cikkekről, ipari technológiáról, energetikáról vagy építéstechnológiáról: Velünk lehetőséged nyílik arra, hogy javíts az emberek életminőségén világszerte.

Köszöntünk a Bosch világában.

A Bosch budapesti telephelye 1991-ben nyitotta meg kapuit. Több, mint 2700 munkatársunk dolgozik közösen. Számtalan fejlesztési projekt mellett, a budapesti telephely dél-kelet európai értékesítési központként regionális feladatokat is ellát, gépjárműalkatrészek, gépjármű-diagnosztikai készülékek, kéziszerszámok, valamint thermotechnikai berendezések és biztonságtechnikai rendszerek területén. Támogató osztályok, mint például a pénzügy, kontrolling, beszerzés, kommunikáció és humán erőforrás, szintén itt végzik tevékenységüket.

Feladatok leírása

  • Autóipari gyártási adatok automatikus feldolgozása, megjelenítése
  • Data Pipeline rendszer fejlesztése Python nyelven (adatkezelés, API, stb.)
  • Idősoros adatbázis kezelése, adatbázis műveletek automatizálása
  • Fejlesztési projektben való aktív részvétel
  • Data Science pipeline fejlesztése (MLOps)
  • Fejlesztő csapat támogatása új technológiák vizsgálatával és értékelésével
  • Projektvezetők munkájának támogatása, költségvetés követése

Elvárások

  • BSC / MSC tanulmányok informatika, villamosmérnöki, mechatronika vagy egyéb műszaki területen
  • programnyelvek ismerete és programozási készségek, Python (pandas, numpy, scipy, matplotlib, tensorflow) és SQL
  • adatbányászat és data science területek elméleti hátterének ismerete
  • gördülékeny kommunikáció nemzetközi csapatban, angol nyelven
  • git verziókezelő szoftver ismerete
  • heti legalább 20 óra vállalása

 

Preferencia/előnyben részesített tudás/készségek:

  • végeselemes módszer ismerete és gyakorlati tapasztalat
  • munkatapasztalat mérnöki/szoftverfejlesztő területen
  • data engineering technológiák ismerete (PySpark, Kubernetes, Docker)
  • objektumorientált programozási készség
  • adatvizualizációs technológiák ismerete (Grafana, PowerBI, Tableau)
  • felhő technológiák ismerete (Microsoft Azure, Databricks)
  • MLOps technológiák ismerete
  • német nyelvtudás
  • ismeretek nagy nyelvi modellek (LLM) témájában

További információk

Ismerd meg mit jelent a Work #LikeABosch.

GROW - Nálunk kibontakozhatsz.

  • Anyagi biztonságot biztosítunk: Versenyképes alapbért és ajánlási bónuszt is kínálunk.
  • Támogatunk szakmai & karriercéljaid elérésében: Hiszünk az élethosszon át tartó fejlődésben, így tanulási és fejlődési lehetőséget kínálunk a szakmai és személyes karrier céljaid eléréshez egyaránt.

 

ENJOY – Velünk teljes életet élhetsz.

  • Egyensúlyban tartunk: Rugalmas munkaidőben dolgozhatsz otthonról vagy modern, kényelmes irodáinkból egyaránt.
  • Fontos vagy számunkra: Ingyenesen biztosított egészségügyi, jogi és pénzügyi tanácsadással, valamint egyéb programokkal és előadásokkal támogatjuk mentális és fizikai egészséged megőrzését.
  • Egyéb juttatásaink: Élvezheted számos munkavállalói kedvezményünk előnyeit, támogatjuk a home office-t, a bejárást, valamint telephelyi étkezésed is.

 

INSPIRE – Inspiráló vállalati kultúránkhoz Te is büszkén tartozol majd.

  • Hűek vagyunk az értékeinkhez: Dolgozz olyan kultúrában, amely értékeli a sokszínűséget, hisz az átláthatóságban és a fenntarthatóságban. Kapcsolódj be társadalmi felelősségvállalási programjainkba, mint például véradási kampányok és jótékonysági tevékenységek.
  • Legnagyobb erősségünk a közösségünk: Részt vehetsz csapatépítőkön és olyan szórakoztató vállalati eseményeken, mint egy nyári piknik, karácsonyi vásár vagy családi nap, valamint csatlakozhatsz aktív belső közösségeinkhez, ahol további izgalmas programlehetőségek várnak.

 

Csatlakozz és Work #LikeABosch.

item.title: Go-to-Market Media Specialist at Tanium
item.description:
The Basics:

This role supports the Demand Generation team by executing and tracking third-party media and keeping campaign operations running across all campaign portfolios. Campaign managers own strategy for their portfolios. This person provides the operational layer and the cross-portfolio view that makes their work faster and more consistent.

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week:  Durham, NC; or Reston, VA.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Third-party media execution: Coordinate vendor packages, quotes, buys, and activation. Prepare and submit spend requests for approval through the standard approval chain, and track spend against approved plans.
  • Content syndication: Manage content syndication programs to support all campaign portfolios, working with campaign managers on asset selection and with vendors on setup, delivery, and lead flow.
  • Vendor performance tracking: Aggregate results by vendor (conversion, engagement, lead quality, pipeline) and surface findings to support vendor tiering decisions made by leadership.
  • Campaign build and admin: Build campaigns from campaign manager requests in Marketo, Salesforce, and 6sense, following naming, tagging, and UTM standards.
  • Asset library: Maintain a current view of available assets across all portfolios so campaign managers can reuse what exists before requesting new content.
  • Lead flow: Own our Lead Management platform to manage lead uploads and flow through to Salesforce.
  • Cross-portfolio visibility: Keep the campaign tracker in Notion current and flag overlaps, gaps, and timing conflicts to campaign managers and leadership.
  • Reporting: Build and maintain vendor and campaign performance reports, including multi-touch attribution views.

 

We’re looking for someone with:

Education 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Experience

  • 2 to 4 years in B2B demand generation, marketing operations, or media coordination
  • Working knowledge of Marketing Automation Platforms (Marketo), Salesforce, and data management / lead management platforms
  • Comfortable with spreadsheets and dashboards; reporting experience is a plus
  • Familiarity with third party media landscape within B2B: content syndication or sponsored media
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage requests from several stakeholders without being chased
  • Leveraging LLM platforms like Claude to automate workflows, process data, and speed up campaign operations and reporting

 

About Tanium 

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company’s autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate. 

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together. 

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.   

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.  

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work. 

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.   

What you’ll get 

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $75,000 to $115,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience. 

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com. For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster.

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

item.title: QA Automation Engineer (SDET) - Dallas, TX Only (Hybrid) at Zimperium
item.description:
Zimperium, Inc. is a global leader in mobile device and app security, offering real-time, on-device protection against both known and unknown threats on Android, iOS and Chromebook endpoints. The company was founded under the premise that the then current state of mobile security was insufficient to solve the growing mobile security problem. At the time, most mobile security was a port from traditional endpoint security technologies. Zimperium recognized mobile devices had unique characteristics needing a completely new approach. The team set to work to reimagine how to protect mobile devices and developed the award winning, patented z9 machine learning-based engine.

As part of our fast-growing pace, we are currently looking for a Software Development in Test (Mobile Applications) to reinforce our team of experts in building robust automation tools and frameworks. This person should have a solid understanding of Quality Assurance, knowledge of distributed system design, web application software, and object-oriented design principles. The test software you build should expose defects in services and application code as well as defects at the component and system integration levels. This role provides an excellent opportunity to lead mobile test automation efforts for both native and cross-platform applications, ensuring robust, secure, and high-quality mobile experiences in a collaborative, agile environment.

Location: Dallas, TX (Hybrid)

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of existing automated test scripts and frameworks.
  • Execute manual and automated test cases for Web and API applications to support sprint goals.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track software defects in Jira.
  • Run regression, smoke, and sanity test suites and analyze results.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning) and contribute to test documentation.
  • Assist in integrating automated tests into TestOps under guidance.
  • Communicate testing progress and blockers to team members clearly.
  • Learn and adopt new testing tools and methodologies as required by the project.

Minimum Requirements:

Qualifications

Experience and Knowledge:

Working Style and Methods:

Personality:

  • Willingness to work with cross-functional teams in an international environment

Mobility:
