item.title: Technical Support Specialist (Philippines - overnight) at Aviron
item.description:
Aviron, a Y-Combinator company, transforms boring workouts into habit-building fitness entertainment through its innovative game-based cardio equipment, including rowing machines, bikes and treadmills. Y-Combinator, a startup incubator renowned for nurturing groundbreaking startups like Airbnb, Dropbox, and Instacart, has been instrumental in Aviron’s journey, supporting rapid growth through two funding rounds totaling ~$35M.

Founded with the mission to End Boring Workouts, our unique approach combines the enjoyment of playing games with the benefits of exercise, crafting an experience that’s fun, effective and even addictive.

We invite you to explore our Facebook community and witness the impact of Aviron firsthand.

Aviron is right for you if

  • You’re looking for a role that prioritizes personal and professional growth
  • You’re looking for a flat organization with friendly people that values merit (i.e. good work)
  • You’re self-motivated and and take pride in producing amazing work
  • You’re not down with office politics
  • You want to own your work, start to finish
  • You are looking to make an impact and see how your work drives growth

Position Overview
We are looking for a fitness-passionate Technical Support Specialist to join our team remotely! You’ll use your strong technical troubleshooting skills to resolve issues with our connected fitness products, including hardware, software, networking, and mobile applications. Your excellent verbal and written communication will help you clearly convey technical information to customers of all backgrounds.

In this dynamic role, you’ll diagnose and address customer issues swiftly, document interactions meticulously, and adapt quickly to new technologies. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems and ensure our customers receive top-notch support. Your ability to multitask and manage multiple inquiries while maintaining high-quality standards is essential.

Bring your understanding of connected fitness products and experience with CRM software and ticketing systems to help us deliver exceptional service. Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, teamwork, work hard/play hard culture, and continuous improvement!

Schedule & Availability

Our Technical Support team helps North American customers between 8:30 AM and 9:00 PM Eastern Time, six days a week.

As a Technical Support Specialist, you will be assigned one of three fixed shifts. All of them are overnight in the Philippines.

Shift options, in Philippine Standard Time (mid-March to early November):

  • Early shift: 8:30 PM to 5:30 AM PHT (8:30 AM to 5:30 PM ET)
  • Mid shift: 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM PHT (10:00 AM to 7:00 PM ET)
  • Late shift: 12:00 AM to 9:00 AM PHT (12:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET)

All shifts cover Tuesday to Saturday ET.

In PHT, the early and mid shifts start Tuesday to Saturday evening, and the late shift runs Wednesday to Sunday.

You always have two consecutive days off.

North America observes Daylight Saving Time and the Philippines does not, so your shift moves one hour later for roughly four months of the year. From early November to mid-March, your hours are:

  • Early shift: 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM PHT
  • Mid shift: 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM PHT
  • Late shift: 1:00 AM to 10:00 AM PHT

Your days off do not change. We give advance notice before each change.

Schedules are set in advance. Each shift is a long-term fixed overnight schedule, not a rotating one, so please apply only if you are confident you can sustain it.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of all company products, channels, and policies/terms, and assist customers with their inquiries in a professional manner.
  • Assist customers with troubleshooting technical issues related to connected fitness equipment, mobile apps, and associated software platforms via phone, email, and or other communication channels.
  • Effectively diagnose hardware and software problems, providing step-by-step guidance to customers to resolve issues with their connected fitness products using knowledge base and guided troubleshooting flows.
  • Document every interaction accurately in the ticketing system with proper categorization including but not restricted to machine model, serial number, reported issue, symptoms, troubleshooting performed, and media evidence.
  • Collaborate with internal teams such as Tier 2 technical support, product development, and quality assurance to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Flag recurring issues, knowledge base gaps and customer feedback to Tier 2 and management.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining detailed documentation for troubleshooting processes, FAQs, and user guides to help both customers and internal teams.
  • Regularly suggest updates for the internal knowledge base with solutions or relevant details to issues and trends.

Qualifications

  • 1-year minimum working in a customer experience role focused on technical support, consumer electronics, SaaS or connected devices.
  • A degree in any Technology, Engineering, Science, Mathematics (STEM) field or equivalent experience.
  • Excellent MS Office knowledge
  • Experience using Zendesk and RingCentral is considered an asset
  • Exceptional verbal and written skills in English with ability to explain technical steps clearly to non-technical customers
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Communication and interpersonal skills
  • Time management skills
  • Ability to learn quickly
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Work setup requirements

Because this is a fully remote overnight role supporting live customers, you will need:

  • A private, quiet workspace suitable for customer calls and video demos
  • Reliable high-speed home internet, with a backup connection such as mobile data
  • A plan for power interruptions, such as a UPS or backup power source
  • The ability to work the overnight Philippine schedule above on a sustained basis

What We Offer

  • 2 weeks paid vacation
  • Sick leave and personal days
  • Health benefits after 3 months
  • Paid statutory holidays
  • Computer and headset after 3 months
  • $25/month for internet coverage

A couple more things

Our customers love us because we are friendly, passionate, and always willing to go the extra mile. They are continuously impressed (even surprised) at the high-quality physical product and software experience we provide. We are very proud of the product and market we’ve carved out as a team/company that was until very recently mostly boot-strapped. We are looking for someone to match (and elevate!) our passion and hard work to the next level during this very exciting time for our company.

Aviron is based in Toronto, Canada, but much of our team is remote, spanning across Canada, the U.S., and Asia. Please note that this role must be based within the Philippines.

Aviron is an equal opportunity employer. We provide a safe and inspiring workplace where everyone is accepted and has the opportunity to grow with us. If you require any accommodations, please let us know.

item.title: Senior iOS Engineer at Zopa Bank
item.description:
Our Story

 

Hello there. We’re Zopa.

 

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 

 

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 

 

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

About the team

 

We are a mobile-first bank, and our iOS app is a critical part of how customers experience Zopa.

Having recently completed our migration to fully native mobile, we are now focused on making our iOS platform exceptional: fast, reliable, accessible and easy for engineers to build on.

You’ll join our Mobile Platform team, which owns the infrastructure, tooling and engineering standards that sit beneath our customer-facing mobile experiences. This includes areas such as app architecture, shared modules, our design system, observability, developer tooling and CI/CD.

The team is accountable for keeping these foundations reliable, scalable and easy for our product squads to build on. You’ll help shape the direction of mobile engineering at Zopa, improve the developer experience, and reduce the underlying technical complexity that product engineers need to manage.

The Mobile Platform team does not own individual customer journeys or build product features on behalf of squads. Product teams remain responsible for their customer experiences and the services they own, including responding to incidents within those product-owned areas. Instead, your focus will be on creating and maintaining the shared capabilities, tooling and standards that enable those teams to deliver safely and effectively.

You’ll also be part of a strong iOS engineering community, contributing to standards, sharing knowledge and helping us continue to mature our native engineering practice.

A Day in the life:

  • Partner closely with the Engineering Manager, Principal Mobile Engineer and Head of Mobile Engineering to deliver Zopa’s mobile strategy.
  • Help shape the technical direction and standards for iOS across Zopa.
  • Design and evolve shared modules, APIs, architecture and developer tooling that enable multiple teams to build and ship with confidence.
  • Identify technical risks early, using data, profiling and observability to improve performance, reliability and developer experience.
  • Stay highly hands-on, delivering production-quality Swift and SwiftUI code across platform and customer-facing product work.
  • Raise the capability of other engineers through pairing, code reviews, technical discussions and knowledge sharing.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, Backend and Android colleagues to make well-rounded decisions, influence direction and respect each discipline’s expertise.

About you:

  • Strong experience building and maintaining customer-facing iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Deep knowledge of iOS development, including concurrency, performance, memory management, testing, accessibility and security.
  • Sound architectural and API-design judgement, with a focus on simple, maintainable solutions and an excellent developer experience.
  • A proactive engineer who identifies problems, shapes practical solutions and influences improvements beyond their immediate team.
  • A collaborative teammate who raises the capability of others through coaching, pairing and knowledge sharing.
  • Comfortable constructively challenging ideas, while remaining open-minded and willing to change course when better evidence emerges.
  • Genuine curiosity about mobile engineering and the evolving iOS platform.

Added bonus:

  • Background in fintech, banking or another regulated, high-trust environment where reliability and customer confidence matter.
  • A track record of building shared libraries, platform capabilities or design systems that help engineering teams move faster.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of UIKit and its place within modern iOS development.
  • Proven impact improving mobile CI/CD pipelines, release processes and developer tooling.
  • Confidence using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and code quality.

#LI-IB1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You’ll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

 

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

 

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn’t something we’re testing out — it’s part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we’re committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don’t use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you’ve approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can’t tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we’re the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don’t. Your Talent Partner will let you know what’s expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we’ll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

item.title: Customer Solution Engineer, Zuora + Workday Financial Management (FINS) at Zuora
item.description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models, from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings, helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We have led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we are building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Zuora and Workday now sell Zuora Billing and Revenue together under one Workday contract. This role makes that partnership win technically in Workday Financial Management (FINS) accounts, both net-new and existing. You will work alongside Workday and Zuora AEs, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, and you will own the technical win.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical win on Workday FINS opportunities: discovery, architecture, objection handling, and clear positioning of Zuora against Workday-native billing and revenue options
  • Map the quote-to-cash and usage model end to end across Workday Revenue Management, Accounting Center, Close & Consolidate, and Services CPQ, showing where Zuora owns metering, rating, mediation, and invoice presentation and where data hands off to Workday
  • Scope and build proofs of concept as the primary mechanism for technical proof, with a forward-deployed engineer mindset, working hands-on with APIs, events, and data integrations between Zuora and Workday tenants
  • Design consumption and AI-driven monetization for Workday customers: prepaid drawdown, flexible commitments, and usage pricing, with the revenue recognition implications made explicit
  • Enable Workday field teams, including FINS sellers, specialists, and consultants, through joint discovery, demos, and certification-ready technical materials
  • Lead C-level technical presentations, translating pricing and architecture trade-offs into business value for CFOs, controllers, and CIOs
  • Stay close to accounts post-sale to protect technical health, drive adoption, and surface share-of-wallet and suite expansion opportunities
  • Share structured customer and field feedback with Product and Solutions teams to shape the Workday integration roadmap
  • Support RFPs, RFIs, joint field events, and customer references as needed
  • Travel within your territory as required

About You

You are a technical solutions professional who has won complex deals alongside Workday or ERP partners and can run a POC without hand-holding.

You bring:

  • 7+ years in sales engineering, presales, or solution architecture in enterprise SaaS
  • Hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management, or with another enterprise ERP and its finance modules (Revenue, Accounting, Close, CPQ), in a partner or co-sell setting
  • Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how it shapes billing and usage models
  • Deep fluency in usage and consumption billing: metering, rating, mediation, prepaid drawdown, and commitment pricing
  • Strong technical depth across REST APIs, event-driven integration, data reconciliation, and ERP-to-billing data flows
  • The ability to troubleshoot a failing integration under pressure, not just describe the architecture
  • Executive communication with CFOs, controllers, and CIOs, and with engineers
  • Experience with MEDDIC or Value Selling
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in FinTech or enterprise software

A strong plus:

  • Workday Financial Management certification, or Workday Revenue Management and Accounting Center experience
  • Experience co-selling with a platform partner’s AEs and SEs
  • Telecom or high-volume usage experience

About the Team

You will sit in the Workday alliance solutions group, working with Account Executives from Zuora and Workday, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, Product, and Solutions. The group exists to win and expand Zuora + Workday Financial Management accounts with a technical story that holds up in front of controllers and CFOs.

The team wants someone who goes beyond standard demos: someone who will shape the solution architecture, own the POC outcome, and help turn Workday’s customer base into durable consumption revenue for Zuora.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. Specific offerings vary by country, but we typically provide:

  • Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
  • Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
  • Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
  • Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
  • Mental wellbeing resources and support

Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process.

#ZEOLife at Zuora

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants needing special assistance or accommodation during the interview process may email assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent).

Compensation

The OTE range for this role is $142,350 - $251,160. OTE includes base salary and target variable compensation. A candidate’s final OTE will be determined based on factors including qualifications, relevant experience, job-related knowledge, specific skills, location and budget.

The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here.

Base Pay Details

$109,500—$193,200 USD

item.title: Vice President of AI Delivery at Keller Executive Search International
item.description:
Keller Executive Search is recruiting a Vice President of Delivery for a client seeking senior leadership of AI-enabled technology delivery. This role combines delivery strategy, client partnership, and organizational leadership, with a focus on turning AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

This opportunity suits a leader who connects technical judgment with commercial discipline. You will shape repeatable delivery practices, develop leaders, and guide teams from discovery through production adoption, maintaining accountability for quality, client success, and delivery economics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define delivery strategy, operating practices, and performance measures for AI-enabled engagements.
  • Oversee execution, resource planning, quality, risk management, and executive escalations across client engagements.
  • Embed AI-assisted workflows, automation, and sound engineering practices into delivery, with measurable improvements in quality and efficiency.
  • Partner with clients to define success measures, manage expectations, and support sustained adoption.
  • Own delivery economics, including capacity, utilization, forecasting, and practice margin.
  • Partner with commercial leaders on proposals, scope, account expansion, and achievable delivery commitments.
  • Develop delivery leaders and build accountable, collaborative teams.
  • Embed responsible AI, evaluation, data protection, security, and human oversight into delivery governance.

Essential

  • At least 10 years of technology delivery experience, including at least 5 years leading delivery teams or organizations.
  • Experience delivering AI-enabled solutions into production with measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience owning delivery budgets, resource plans, and engagement or practice profitability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead senior client relationships and resolve complex delivery challenges.
  • Working knowledge of generative AI, AI-assisted development, software delivery lifecycles, evaluation methods, and responsible AI practices.
  • Ability to develop managers, lead cross-functional teams, and communicate technical trade-offs to executive audiences.
  • Availability for a hybrid working pattern and occasional travel.

Preferred

  • Experience leading delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Experience scaling delivery practices, reusable methods, and performance reporting.
  • Experience supporting proposals, account growth, and adoption of AI-enabled workflows.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a commercially minded delivery leader who balances ambition with execution discipline. You earn client confidence, coach leaders, and distinguish useful AI applications from experimentation without a clear business case. You are equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs and business performance.

  • Salary: $275,000-300,000 base
  • Annual performance bonus tied to performance
  • Health benefits with Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • Full-time role on a hybrid pattern of at least two days a week in the office, plus regular in-person time with senior leadership and clients
  • Occasional travel of about one to two days a month for client site visits and important in-person client meetings

Agency statement

Keller is a recruitment agency that provides services to clients ranging from startups and non profits to multinational corporations. Keller emphasizes ethical search processes, attentive candidate care, and leadership placements that support long-term client outcomes.

To learn more about the firm and about our candidate services - please visit our website

Equal Opportunity policy

Equal Employment Opportunity and Non-Discrimination Policy

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: Both Keller Executive Search and our clients are Equal Opportunity Employers. For all positions, whether with Keller Executive Search or our clients, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, skin color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

Commitment to Diversity: Keller Executive Search and its clients are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where all individuals are valued and respected.

Reasonable Accommodations: Both Keller Executive Search and our clients are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and pregnant individuals. We engage in an interactive process to determine effective, reasonable accommodations.

Compensation Information: For client positions, compensation information is available in the job post. If not provided, it will be shared during the interview process in accordance with applicable laws. When required by law, salary ranges will be included in job postings. Actual salary may depend on skills, experience, and comparison to current employees in similar roles. Salary ranges may vary based on role and location.

Compliance with Laws: Both Keller Executive Search and our clients comply with federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all employment terms and conditions, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Workplace Harassment: Both Keller Executive Search and our clients expressly prohibit any form of workplace harassment based on race, skin color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

E-Verify Participation: Keller Executive Search and/or our clients may participate in E-Verify. Information about E-Verify participation will be provided during the application process where applicable.

Privacy and Pay Equity:

  • California Residents: For more information about the categories of personal information we collect for recruiting and employment purposes, please review our Privacy Policy at www.kellerexecutivesearch.com.
  • Colorado, Nevada, New York City, California, and Washington Residents: Compensation information is available in the job post or will be provided during the interview process if not initially available.
  • Both Keller Executive Search and our clients are committed to pay equity and conduct periodic pay equity analyses in accordance with applicable laws.

State-Specific Information:

  • Rhode Island: We do not request or require salary history from applicants.
  • Connecticut: We provide wage range information upon request or before discussing compensation.
  • New Jersey: We do not inquire about salary history unless voluntarily disclosed.

Veteran Status: Both Keller Executive Search and our clients provide equal employment opportunities to veterans and comply with applicable state laws regarding veteran preference in employment. If you are a veteran, please inform us during the application process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Keller Executive Search and our clients may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the recruitment and candidate evaluation process. These tools are used exclusively to support human decision-making by helping to review and assess candidate qualifications and materials. AI is never used to automatically reject, disqualify, or make final hiring decisions about candidates. All AI-assisted evaluations are reviewed by experienced recruitment professionals, and all hiring decisions are made by qualified human recruiters. Our use of AI is designed to enhance fairness, consistency, and efficiency while maintaining our commitment to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination principles.

Genetic Information: In accordance with federal and state laws, both Keller Executive Search and our clients do not discriminate based on genetic information. We do not request or require genetic information from applicants or employees, except as permitted by law.

Local Laws: Both Keller Executive Search and our clients comply with all applicable local laws and ordinances regarding employment practices in the areas where we operate.

 

Note: This job posting may be for a position with Keller Executive Search or one of our clients. The specific employer will be identified during the application and interview process. Employment laws and requirements may vary depending on the employer and location.

item.title: Sr. Information Security & Privacy Analyst at AvePoint
item.description:
AvePoint is seeking an Information Security & Privacy Analyst for our Global Privacy, Security and Risk Team. This role will have a strong focus on Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), Vendor Lifecycle and Integration Management,.

The Analyst will help evaluate and manage security, privacy, compliance, and operational risks throughout the vendor lifecycle, from initial assessment and onboarding through ongoing monitoring, integration, reassessment, and offboarding. The role will also support the management and continuous improvement of technology asset inventories and GRC systems, helping ensure accurate, actionable information is available to support risk and compliance decisions. This is a great opportunity for someone interested in developing practical experience across TPRM, GRC, security, privacy, vendor governance, and asset management at a large and innovative software company.

What will you be doing?

  • Support the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program, including security, privacy, compliance, and operational assessments of vendors and service providers.
  • Coordinate vendor lifecycle activities, including intake, due diligence, onboarding, risk classification, periodic reassessment, integration and change reviews, renewals, and offboarding.
  • Manage vendor relationships for software solutions, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, and issue resolution, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance requirements for both licensed and non-licensed applications.
  • Lead and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate functionality, usability, and performance against business requirements, documenting results and facilitating stakeholder sign-off prior to deployment.
  • Evaluate technical security controls—such as access management, encryption standards, and vulnerability assessments—to safeguard licensed and non-licensed software, ensuring adherence to internal policies and regulatory frameworks.
  • Assess AI capabilities in both new and existing vendors, analyzing their tools, models, and integration potential to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen security posture, and ensure ethical and compliant use of AI technologies.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Security, Privacy, IT, Procurement, Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders to identify, document, track, and remediate vendor-related risks.
  • Help maintain a centralized inventory of vendors, technology assets, software, systems, integrations, business owners, and associated risk and compliance information.
  • Review new and existing vendor integrations to understand data flows, access requirements, authentication methods, system dependencies, and potential security and privacy risks.
  • Create clear and effective technical and business communications for a variety of stakeholders and audiences.
  • Support cross functional responsibilities of the Privacy and Security Teams as needed

OK, I’m interested… is this the job for me?

We look for people who value agility, passion, teamwork, and accountability; people who can bring fresh ideas to the table and want the opportunity to learn, grow, and expand their careers. You should be comfortable working across technical and business teams, asking thoughtful questions, organizing complex information, and following risks and action items through resolution.

This role is particularly well suited for someone who enjoys understanding how vendors, technology assets, applications, data, risks, controls, and business processes connect, and who wants to help build scalable governance around those relationships.

Other qualities you’ll need to be a fit for this role include:

  • BA/BS degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Risk Management, Business, Engineering, or another relevant field preferred, but not required.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent attention to detail, documentation, and organizational abilities.
  • Familiarity with Third-Party Risk Management, vendor assessments, GRC, vendor management, IT asset management, or technology lifecycle management is strongly preferred.
  • General understanding of cloud services, SaaS applications, system integrations, APIs, identity and access management, networking, and data flows.
  • Familiarity with GRC, TPRM, ITSM, Asset Management, or vendor management platforms is a plus.
  • Ability to review vendor security and privacy documentation, questionnaires, certifications, audit reports, and other assurance materials and identify potential areas of risk.
  • Ability to maintain accurate information within GRC and Asset Management systems, including ownership, risk, control, assessment, remediation, and lifecycle information.
  • Ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and maintain accurate records of owners, decisions, risks, remediation items, approvals, and lifecycle status.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate technical risk into clear, practical business language.
  • Strong interest in privacy, cybersecurity, third-party risk, AI governance, asset management, and GRC.
  • A proactive mindset and interest in helping develop and improve processes rather than simply administering existing ones.

 

Benefits We Offer  

  • Competitive market-based compensation (salary, yearly bonus + equity).
  • Career progression and internal mobility opportunities.
  • Work-life balance through a hybrid working model.
  • Unlimited PTO.

The Salary Range for this role is $120,000 - $160,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

 

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

item.title: Software Engineer at NBCUniversal
item.description:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world’s leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the VOD Engineering team, responsible for building and evolving large-scale media processing systems. This is a high-impact, hands-on role focused on designing, building, and operating distributed systems that power the ingestion, processing, and delivery of video content at scale.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take ownership, proactively identify improvements, and build systems that are reliable, performant, and scalable in real-world conditions.

What the team does

  • The VOD Engineering team builds E2E video on demand solutions
  • The VOD team is responsible for the automated media pipeline delivering content to NBCU’s streaming platforms including Peacock.
  • Troubleshoots issues arising in the VOD pipeline.
  • Configures encoding of video, audio and subtitles for delivery across various platforms/devices.
  • Research new technologies in the media space and conduct POCs.
  • Collaborates with Operations, player and client teams to drive innovation and improvements in video delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and continuously improve scalable media pipelines for processing, transforming, and delivering large-volume media content.
  • Implement and productionize core algorithms for media analysis, computer vision, or machine learning workloads where they can materially improve the platform.
  • Build distributed systems and services that raise the bar on reliability, performance, observability, and operational scale.
  • Partner across engineering and product to identify problems and opportunities early, then turn them into technical design, milestones, and execution plans.
  • Bring a builder’s mindset to day-to-day engineering, using strong judgment, modern tooling, and pragmatic execution to move systems forward.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience building, operating, and improving media pipelines at scale
  • Experience designing, deploying, and evolving distributed systems in production
  • Fluency in Python, plus proficiency in Go, C++, and/or Rust
  • Experience with performance optimization, observability, and reliability engineering for large-scale platforms
  • Experience working with Unix-based environments, source control, and production software development workflows
  • Ownership mindset, with the ability to identify problems, drive solutions, and turn business needs into scalable technical systems
  • Comfort working in agent-assisted development workflows, using AI tools to accelerate implementation, iterate on solutions, and produce production-quality pull requests

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
  • Min 2 years of experience in engineering, software architecture and design
  • Familiarity with video compression concepts, including inter-frame encoding concepts
  • Familiarity with container, transport, and multiplexing formats used in media workflows, plus exposure to FFmpeg, x264, and x265
  • Experience with machine learning, computer vision, or media analysis systems
  • Experience with open-source projects, experimentation, and pushing systems beyond the obvious solution

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $105,000 - $145,000.

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal’s policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to [email protected].

item.title: Engineering Manager at NBCUniversal
item.description:
Company Description

NBCUniversal is one of the world’s leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

The Core Video iOS team is looking for an exceptional Engineering Manager to grow and develop our international talent base into a first-class team of engineers. Join us as we redefine the future of streaming video technology for the iOS and tvOS platforms. Together, we will shape our culture, solve technical problems, and create extraordinary streaming experiences that captivate audiences worldwide.

Essential Functions (Responsibilities):

  • Own the public playback API for iOS and tvOS, including session lifecycle, configuration, player events, and the error model, and manage the relationship with the client applications that depend on it.
  • Own SDK release mechanics, including versioning, deprecation windows, and migration guidance for client applications.
  • Uphold playback KPI targets for startup time, rebuffering, seek behavior, and fatal-error recovery on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV across supported OS versions.
  • Direct the design of adaptive bitrate, buffering, live and on-demand playback, content protection, and ad insertion inside the SDK.
  • Decide where playback stays on AVFoundation and where the stack needs custom work for threading, main-thread safety, memory, and thermal limits.
  • Use production playback telemetry, including startup, rebuffering, error rate, and device-specific failures, to prioritize engineering work and to lead technical triage on playback incidents.
  • Define the playback library’s test strategy, including automated golden scenarios, content-protection and ads edge cases, and device-level regression on iOS and tvOS.
  • Represent iOS and tvOS constraints in wider architecture decisions, including FairPlay, AVPlayer behavior, and Apple TV input and display limits.
  • Apply AI in solution design, code review, and production investigation, and keep the team accountable for the public API and for what ships.
  • Mentor and coach team members.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, understand user needs, and provide technical direction.
  • Strive to constantly improve the overall quality through code reviews, tech talks, pair programming and other collaborative practices.
  • Understand business needs and design valuable software solutions that work well within the wider architecture.
  • Proactively estimate efforts and identify any potential risks.
  • Manage team roadmap and capacity.
  • Push technical boundaries while also recommending new processes and technologies.
  • Help foster an environment of inclusiveness

Qualifications

  • 4 years of leading an engineering team with prior senior-level experience in iOS SDK development
  • Must have an enthusiasm for building an iOS library that handles all aspects of video playback.
  • Value collaboration with teammates and stakeholders.
  • Understanding deadlines, constraints and scope of delivery and experience working with stakeholders to ensure the right balance between these are met, setting expectations and handling risks early.
  • Being an analytic problem solver with a strong sense of autonomy, and with an open collaborative approach to getting the job done.
  • Interest in cultivating a strong team culture where engineers of diverse backgrounds can grow.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $140,000 - $200,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal’s policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to [email protected].

item.title: Account Executive, Fuel & Retail at Mashgin
item.description:
About Mashgin

Mashgin powers the world’s best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional.

Mashgin’s technology powers over 1 billion transactions at your favorite locations, including over half of all US professional sports teams, 4,000 convenience stores, major airports, universities, and more.

We’re not just building cutting-edge AI—we’re creating real-world impact and unforgettable experiences. Backed by a well-funded Series B, we’re also one of the rare AI startups that’s already profitable.

Our secret? A culture of extreme ownership, autonomy, and customer obsession. At Mashgin, we are building something extraordinary by challenging conventional wisdom. We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, ‘Wow’. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. If you thrive in a culture of excellence without compromise and want to see your work have an immediate, remarkable impact, you’re in the right place.

Position Overview 

We’re looking for an Account Executive to grow Mashgin’s presence across the fuel, convenience store and retail industries. This is a new business-focused role where you’ll build your own pipeline, develop relationships with prospective customers, and drive sales from initial outreach through close.

With Mashgin’s technology already in 4,000 convenience stores, there’s a significant opportunity to grow our footprint. You’ll focus on identifying and winning new business with small to mid-sized operators and multi-location retailers, helping them improve the checkout experience for their customers.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, and closing new business. Experience in fuel, convenience or retail is a plus, but not a requirement.

What We Value:

  • Impact: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
  • Simplicity: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
  • Hard Work: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it’s high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
  • Efficiency: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and prospect new customers across the fuel, convenience store and retail industries through outbound outreach, industry events and referrals
  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial outreach and discovery to product demos, pricing, negotiation and close
  • Build relationships with business owners, operators and key decision-makers to understand their needs and identify how Mashgin can support their business
  • Identify opportunities to grow Mashgin’s presence across customers’ existing and future store locations
  • Represent Mashgin at industry trade shows and events, including NACS and NATSO
  • Partner with sales engineering, deployment, marketing and product teams to support the sales process and ensure a smooth customer handoff
  • Share customer and industry insights to help inform our sales strategy and product development
  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in HubSpot while consistently working toward sales targets

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of closing experience in B2B sales, ideally selling hardware, software or technology solutions
  • A track record of prospecting, generating new business and closing deals
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle and engaging with key decision-makers
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach to sales with a willingness to take initiative
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and identify growth opportunities
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growing company
  • Willingness to travel up to 25–30% for industry events and customer meetings, primarily on the East Coast and in the Midwest

Nice to have

  • Experience selling into convenience stores, fuel retail, grocery, hospitality or foodservice
  • Familiarity with point-of-sale, self-checkout, payments or retail technology
  • Existing relationships within the convenience store or fuel retail industries
  • Experience working at a startup or high-growth company
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work on a small, multidisciplinary team with the potential to break new ground in many different industries
  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • 401k plan
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Catered lunch in office with fully stocked snacks and beverages
  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Voluntary life insurance plan
  • Competitive salary and options in a small, rapidly scaling company

Salary

Base salary starting at $130,000+, depending on experience and qualifications, plus commission.

Note that total compensation for this position will be determined by candidate’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other relevant factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered by Mashgin, and the potential future value of any other long-term incentives.

Mashgin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Mashgin are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. 

Notice on fraudulent jobs

We have been made aware of instances of fraudulent job postings and/or fraudulent recruiting activity by bad actors, claiming to represent Mashgin. These fraudulent schemes often seek monetary contributions or payments from job seekers (such as for “start up costs” or “equipment”), or seek to collect sensitive personal or banking information from job seekers. These job postings and offers are not authorized by Mashgin, and Mashgin is not responsible for fraudulent offers or requests for personal information or payments. Mashgin will never ask for any financial commitment or contribution from a candidate at any stage of the recruitment process. Candidates who have questions about the validity of Mashgin job postings or offers should consult the job postings on our mashgin.com career site. If you think you’ve been scammed, please reference this site for more information.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

item.title: Director of Engineering at Greenshades Software
item.description:
Department: Development 
Supervisor: Chief Technology Officer 
Supervises: Engineering Team 
Type: Full-time Regular 
Classification: Exempt 
Travel Required: Up to 15% 
Location: This is a remote position. 

Role Summary 

The Director of Engineering leads Greenshades’ development organization, ensuring the delivery of reliable, scalable, and secure payroll, HR, and workforce management software. This role sets engineering direction, builds and develops high-performing leaders and teams, and owns the metrics that define how engineering performs. You will partner with Product, QA, and executive leadership to turn business priorities into predictable outcomes, while championing platform reliability, engineering excellence, and an AI-first approach to building software. 

Responsibilities 

  • Lead, coach, and develop Engineering Managers and Engineering Leads, building a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Own the engineering roadmap and delivery execution, aligning technical priorities with product strategy and business goals.
  • Own engineering metrics end to end: define, instrument, and report on delivery, quality, reliability, and productivity measures, and hold teams accountable for improving them.
  • Use engineering metrics to drive decisions on capacity, process, and investment, and communicate results and trends clearly to the CTO and senior leadership.
  • Drive platform reliability, performance, and scalability across multi-tenant, compliance-sensitive systems.
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards for architecture, code quality, security, testing, and release practices.
  • Lead the adoption of AI-first engineering practices across the organization, including agentic development workflows, tooling, and governance, and measure their impact on productivity, quality, and cost.
  • Partner with Product, QA, Customer Experience, and Implementations to prioritize work and resolve cross-functional dependencies.
  • Manage engineering capacity, hiring, resource planning, and budget in partnership with executive leadership.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements 

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and managing engineering managers or multiple teams.
  • Proven track record delivering and operating production SaaS platforms at scale, ideally in payroll, HR, fintech, or another regulated domain.
  • Hands-on experience leading AI-assisted software development at team or organizational scale, including coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled testing and code review.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn AI adoption into measurable results, such as improved throughput, quality, or cycle time, and to manage AI tooling costs and licensing.
  • Working knowledge of AI governance in engineering, including security, data privacy, intellectual property, and human review of AI-generated code.
  • Experience defining and owning engineering metrics (such as DORA measures, quality, reliability, and productivity indicators) and using them to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Strong technical foundation in modern engineering practices, with experience in .NET/C#, SQL Server, and cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience hiring, developing, and retaining diverse engineering talent, and managing performance with clarity and fairness.

item.title: Staff Software Engineer, Canvas Logic & Execution at Braze
item.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Canvas Logic and Execution (CLX) team manages the full platform lifecycle of Canvas and Campaigns, our flagship products for marketing automation workflows. Owning mission-critical, high-scale, and high-performance systems, this team is responsible for processing billions of asynchronous jobs and operates on global infrastructure spanning multiple cloud providers.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join the CLX team as a hands-on technical leader. You will create and own complex systems end to end, expanding the capabilities of our platform to support increasingly complex and personalized real-time workflows at massive scale. You will own the team’s technical direction: what we build and how we build it. Architecture, performance, and cost are constant considerations, but your success will be measured by the value you unlock for customers. 

WHO YOU ARE

  • Extensive Software Engineering experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on work in full-stack development or back-end services, particularly with high-scale, high-throughput systems
  • Product Ownership at Scale: proven track record of delivering customer-facing products on high-scale and distributed systems, from problem definition through launch and adoption. You can point to what customers or the business gained, not only what the system did
  • Technical Leadership: skilled at driving architectural direction, scoping large efforts, and effectively managing technical debt. Known for precise communication of complex technical concepts and a track record of driving major technical initiatives
  • Strong Fundamentals: deep understanding of software design, data structures, and algorithms
  • Self-Starter: great communication and organizational skills, with a history of thriving in team environments

Bonus:

  • Experience with MongoDB, Redis, Datadog, Kubernetes, React, Ruby, Ruby on Rails

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $184,000 - $299,812/annually, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $204,000 - $332,400/annually (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We’re committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

  • To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
  • To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com.

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review. 

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

item.title: Strategic Partnerships Lead - GovCon Business Development at CivicActions
item.description:
CivicActions is a mission-minded company. We focus on helping the government deliver better services through modern software practices. We work in cross-functional, agile teams and communicate openly and honestly. We encourage a balanced, autonomous lifestyle. We are looking for others like us with a true passion for using technology to change our world positively.

We’re working toward a future where government has greater independence, flexibility, and control over its digital systems. That means helping agencies move beyond dependence on proprietary technologies and single-vendor solutions toward open, resilient ecosystems that encourage competition, innovation, and long-term public benefit.

We’re building on more than 20 years of experience in government modernization while expanding our partnerships, capabilities, and ability to take on larger, more complex challenges.

CivicActions has a joint venture (JV), CivicLabs, with Huntridge Labs, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), delivering AI and data services to mission-critical federal programs.

We operate as a fully remote team grounded in our values of balance, openness, and care.

Role Overview

CivicActions is seeking a Strategic Partnerships Lead to develop new federal business opportunities that advance our three-year strategy. You’ll build trusted relationships with agency leaders, acquisition professionals, and industry partners early in the planning process, before formal solicitations are released.

You’ll identify where legacy systems, proprietary tools, or vendor lock-in limit an agency’s options and help it explore open-source, modular, and multi-vendor approaches that give it more control over its technology. You’ll also build the partnerships CivicActions and CivicLabs need to pursue larger, more complex modernization efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with federal civilian agency leaders, program teams, and acquisition professionals to understand their modernization priorities and identify emerging opportunities.
  • Track agency budgets, incumbent contracts, recompete timelines, and procurement trends. Use that information to recommend where CivicActions should invest its business development efforts.
  • Build early teaming relationships with digital services firms, prime contractors, small businesses, and open-source organizations. Represent CivicActions and CivicLabs at industry events and government forums.
  • Discuss modernization options and acquisition pathways with agency and industry stakeholders. Identify relevant vehicles, such as GWACs, BPAs, and OTAs, and conduct all pre-solicitation engagement in accordance with federal procurement integrity and ethics requirements.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline. Work with Sales and Delivery to assess strategic fit, competitive position, partners, and next steps, then hand off well-developed opportunities to capture and proposal teams.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • At least five years of experience in business development, market development, or relationship management in the U.S. federal technology or government contracting market.
  • Demonstrated success developing federal opportunities before formal solicitation, including work involving complex technology programs, enterprise systems, or modernization initiatives.
  • Established relationships with federal civilian agency stakeholders or relevant industry partners, and a strong understanding of how federal agencies plan and acquire technology.
  • Ability to connect agency technology challenges to practical modernization and acquisition options, with working knowledge of Agile delivery, human-centered design, cloud technology, and free and open-source software.
  • Experience collaborating with capture, proposal, technical, and delivery teams to advance qualified opportunities.
  • Ability to pass a federal background investigation and work from a dedicated, secure home office with high-speed internet.
  • Availability to travel to the Washington, DC metro area for approximately one business week per month, with expenses paid, and to attend quarterly sales meetings and an annual company summit.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll build trusted relationships in priority agencies and consistently turn early conversations into qualified opportunities. Sales and Delivery will have the customer insight, teaming relationships, and acquisition context they need to decide where to compete and pursue work that expands CivicActions’ impact.

Compensation

The anticipated annual base salary range is $140,000–$150,000, depending on relevant experience and qualifications. The role is also eligible for performance-based incentive compensation. We’ll share more about the incentive structure during the interview process.

Location

We are a fully remote team based in the United States. Team members are expected to have a dedicated workspace and reliable high-speed internet.

Why CivicActions

We believe that when people are supported and well-cared for, they can do their best work and live balanced, fulfilling lives. Our benefits are designed to support your health, growth, and life outside of work.

Our benefits include: 

  • Fully remote work (always)
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage for employees, with company contributions toward dependent coverage
  • 401(k) with a 3% company contribution
  • Flexible time off policy
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave
