item.title: IT Operations and Security Manager at Brilliant Corners
item.description:
Location: This role will operate out of Brilliant Corners’ Los Angeles or San Francisco office.

Salary: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Organization Overview

Founded in 2004, Brilliant Corners provides innovative housing and housing-related services to California’s most vulnerable individuals, with an emphasis on those transitioning from, or at risk of, homelessness or institutionalization. We develop, own, and manage multi-family supportive housing and licensed residential care homes. We implement a broad array of scattered-site, one-on-one supportive housing, and clinical case management programs through partnerships with developmental services, homeless services, veterans’ services, and health care sectors.

In short, we do good work.

We have offices statewide with a staff of passionate people. While we are growing rapidly, we are also selective: We’re seeking inspired, talented people who want to be effecting profound change and who have fun doing it.

Position Summary  

The Manager, Technology Operations & Security is responsible for ensuring Brilliant Corners’ technology environment remains secure, resilient, compliant, and scalable. This role provides leadership for IT operations, cybersecurity, risk management, business continuity, vendor management, and technology planning.

 

The Manager serves as a strategic partner within the Data & Technology Department, balancing operational excellence with long-term planning. This role focuses on organizational resilience, security, compliance, governance, and technology operations while ensuring reliable technology services for staff across the organization.

Team Leadership & Operations

  • Lead, coach, and develop the IT team, including performance management and professional growth.
  • Set operational priorities and service delivery standards, and monitor support metrics to keep service responsive and customer-focused.
  • Oversee the reliability of network, office, and end-user technology, including through vendors and during office moves.
  • Drive continuous improvement of IT processes and service delivery.
  • Build cross-training plans and skills matrices so no critical operation depends on one person.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Own IT, cybersecurity, and data management policies, standards, and procedures, including acceptable use of technology and AI tools, backup, and data retention, and review them on a regular cycle.
  • Oversee and ensure completion of annual security reviews, including penetration testing and other security testing required by contracts, by working with third-party assessors, reviewing findings, and tracking remediation to completion.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments (including the HIPAA security risk analysis) and security reviews of new technologies, software, and vendors.
  • Identify, assess, and regularly report on technology security risks and security posture to leadership, and develop and track mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure alignment with contractual, regulatory (including HIPAA), funder, and organizational security requirements, coordinating with the Contracts team.
  • Provide oversight and direction for security monitoring and incident response, including through third-party providers.
  • Serve as liaison to organizational leadership during incidents, including notification and reporting obligations, support external communications as directed by leadership, and lead post-incident review.
  • Own the security awareness training program for all staff.
  • Oversee periodic access reviews, including privileged and emergency access, and system log review as compliance controls.
  • Support audits, funder security assessments, security questionnaires, and cyber insurance requirements.

Vendor & Asset Management

  • Own IT vendor relationships, including contracts, renewals, performance management, and vendor compliance with security and HIPAA requirements (such as business associate agreements).
  • Develop vendor sourcing and support strategies, including managed-service and repair vendors that reduce routine maintenance work for the team.
  • Review proposed technology purchases across the organization for integration, supportability, licensing, cost, and operational impact.
  • Oversee software licensing, utilization, and hardware lifecycle planning, partnering with Finance and Data & Technology leadership on procurement and renewals.

Planning & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain the IT roadmap and multi-year investment strategy in partnership with Data & Technology leadership, aligning technology spending with organizational priorities.
  • Participate in departmental budgeting and technology planning.
  • Identify emerging risks and opportunities in technology, cybersecurity, automation, and artificial intelligence.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase resilience, efficiency, and security.

Governance & Documentation

  • Establish standards for operational documentation and knowledge management, and audit coverage for critical systems, access controls, and recovery procedures.
  • Ensure every critical system has a named primary and backup owner, with succession plans in place.
  • Support technology governance initiatives across the department.

Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery plans for critical systems and services, and ensure they are tested on a set schedule.
  • Coordinate recovery planning and continuity exercises with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Ensure organizational readiness for technology disruptions and emergencies.

Cross-Department Partnership

  • Partner with People Operations/HR on the employee lifecycle, owning access and device policies for onboarding and offboarding.
  • Collaborate with Product Development, Data & Analytics, Data & Systems Enablement, Finance Systems, and other teams so technology operations support business needs.
  • Provide operational and security expertise for enterprise technology initiatives, including the evaluation and adoption of emerging tools such as AI.

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of IT experience, including 2+ years leading or supervising technical staff.
  • Experience developing and maintaining IT security policies, conducting risk assessments, and supporting audits or contractual security requirements.
  • Experience overseeing third-party security assessments and penetration tests, interpreting findings, and driving remediation.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, contracts, licensing, and budgets, including vendor security and third-party risk assessment.
  • Experience with business continuity, disaster recovery, and security incident response planning.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, and a cloud identity platform such as Okta, in a cloud-first, distributed organization.
  • Highly desirable: experience ensuring HIPAA Business Associate compliance.
  • Desirable: experience in housing, healthcare, or social services.
  • Desirable: security management or healthcare privacy and security certification such as CISM, CISSP, or HCISPP, or equivalent experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent people skills, including collaboration and relationship building.
  • Ability to coach technical staff, delegate effectively, and build redundancy into team knowledge and coverage.
  • Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making.
  • Ability to explain technical and security risk clearly to non-technical leaders, funders, and partners, and to write clear policies and procedures.
  • Strong listener; empathic and curious.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of identity management fundamentals and experience managing an identity provider, preferably Okta or Entra ID.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and the security, privacy, and governance risks they introduce.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and protected information with the utmost discretion.

Core Competencies

Dealing with Ambiguity: Remains productive and effective in uncertain, rapidly changing situations by quickly analyzing information to adapt approach. Demonstrates flexibility, composure and good judgment despite challenges

Technical Learning: Quickly learns and applies new technical skills, knowledge, and industry expertise. Seeks guidance when needed to ensure quality

Problem Solving: Uses critical thinking to creatively investigate issues from diverse perspectives. Makes evidence-based recommendations addressing short and long-term needs

Total Work Systems: Designs, implements, and improves organization-wide systems to enhance quality and efficiency. Leverages technology and data to standardize workflows and meet stakeholder needs

Organizational Agility: Understands how the organization operates through formal and informal structures. Navigates dynamics, communicates rationale behind policies, and builds relationships to achieve goals

Customer Focus: Proactively understands and meets others’ needs through a service-minded approach. Builds trust, leverages insights, and provides responsive support to align with evolving requirements

 

Organizational Values

_Humanity:_Putting people first: We are committed to meeting people where they’re at, honoring their dignity, diversity, and experience.

Community: Building a better future: Sustainable housing solutions are fostered through partnership, collaboration, and human connection.

Ingenuity: Innovating for transformation: Systems-change requires relentless determination, thinking outside the box and challenging the status quo.

Physical Requirements

Candidates should have physical mobility for tasks such as standing, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, twisting, and walking on uneven surfaces. They should be capable of performing stationary tasks like sitting for up to 6 to 8 hours a day.  Additionally, candidates should be able to lift, carry, push, pull light to moderate weights up to 15 pounds safely. Requires mental acuity for analytical reasoning and document interpretation.

 

Salary range for this position is $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year annually. This position is being offered at $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year annually.

 

_Brilliant Corners does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status, in any of its activities or operations. These activities include, but are not limited to, hiring and firing of staff, selection of volunteers and vendors, and provision of services. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients._ We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental, & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (With 5% Match)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary and AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Training & Development
  • Wellness Resources
  • Hybrid Work

item.title: Senior / Staff AI Engineer at Homebound
item.description:
About Us:

Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. 

We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us.

About The Role:

Homebound is seeking an exceptional Senior/Staff AI Engineer to accelerate our mission of building the leading vertical AI stack for residential construction. Our proprietary platform captures granular data at every stage of the homebuilding process, enabling us to develop novel LLM-powered applications that improve efficiency and quality across the board.

We are a small, fast-moving team with multiple AI products already in production and a rapidly growing AI platform. In this role, you will lead the research and implementation of cutting-edge advancements in AI, design and deploy impactful features, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the future of homebuilding.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Shape the vision for how AI, particularly LLMs, integrate into Homebound’s products and operations. Define technical standards for experimentation, deployment, and evaluation.
  • Design and build scalable AI systems that can handle real-world production workloads and evolve with the business.
  • Deliver high-quality, production-grade code daily while ensuring observability, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Raise the bar across engineering by teaching AI best practices, reviewing designs, and guiding engineers through complex technical challenges.
  • Stay abreast of the rapidly evolving AI landscape, bringing forward cutting-edge ideas while focusing investment where it creates clear business impact.

What You Have Done In Your Career:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on AI systems.

  • Shipped LLM-powered features into production, including hands-on experience with some or all of the following:

    • RAG
    • eval frameworks
    • agentic loops.
    • sandboxes for agents
    • systems to edit memory
    • managing subagents
    • Pydantic AI
    • agent observability

  • Fluency in Python. Proven ability to design systems that balance rapid experimentation with long-term reliability and maintainability.

  • A strong understanding of metrics and data science logic

Who You Are:

  • You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes.
  • You’re excited to learn and grow as part of a small, nimble, high-impact team.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively - especially in writing without AI assistance.
  • You’re humble, good-natured, and bring a positive energy to your team.

Our Commitment:

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page.

Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our Compensation Philosophy:

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here.

item.title: Key Account Manager – xp SAAS Comptable _ remote H/F at RCA
item.description:
Description de l’entreprise

Editeur de logiciels 100% autonome, basé en périphérie de Nantes, RCA développe deux gammes de logiciels : Une gamme de 12 modules à destination des cabinets d’expertise comptable et une plateforme digitale collaborative en mode SaaS destinée aux experts-comptables ainsi qu’à leurs clients (TPE).

Depuis 15 ans, la société n’a cessé d’évoluer. Avec 3 personnes en 2007, nous sommes aujourd’hui 300 collaborateurs engagés dans l’aventure RCA !

Description du poste

Tes objectifs

Tu développes le portefeuille Grands Comptes de RCA en fidélisant les cabinets existants et en conquérant de nouveaux comptes à fort potentiel. Tu construis des partenariats durables avec leurs décideurs et portes leur voix auprès des équipes Produit et Marketing pour faire évoluer notre offre et accompagner la profession dans son pivot vers une économie de service.

Tes missions

1. Développer les comptes stratégiques existants

  • Élaborer les plans de compte des cabinets stratégiques et identifier leur potentiel de développement
  • Cartographier le parc des cabinets et détecter les opportunités d’Upsell/Cross-Sell
  • Développer et entretenir un réseau de décideurs au sein des grands cabinets
  • Identifier les opportunités complémentaires liées aux licences, à l’accompagnement, à la formation ou à la personnalisation

2. Conquérir de nouveaux grands comptes

  • Identifier, qualifier et prospecter de nouveaux comptes à fort potentiel
  • Développer un réseau auprès des acteurs structurants de la profession
  • Construire une stratégie d’approche par compte
  • Organiser les rendez-vous de découverte, démonstrations, ateliers et soutenances

3. Piloter les ventes complexes

  • Piloter des cycles de vente complexes, longs et multi interlocuteurs
  • Comprendre les enjeux stratégiques, organisationnels et métiers des cabinets
  • Construire des propositions commerciales adaptées, en collaboration avec les équipes internes
  • Répondre aux appels d’offres et consultations complexes
  • Négocier les conditions commerciales et contractualiser les affaires
  • Suivre les opportunités, les prévisions et les actions commerciales dans Salesforce

4. Porter la voix des grands comptes

  • Collecter, qualifier et formaliser les besoins spécifiques des grands comptes, au-delà des seules opportunités commerciales
  • Distinguer les besoins récurrents du segment des demandes particulières à un client
  • Porter la voix des grands comptes et structurer la remontée de leurs attentes auprès des équipes Produit et Marketing
  • Mener un travail d’influence interne pour faire évoluer les produits, les offres, les argumentaires et les actions marketing en cohérence avec les besoins du segment
  • Contribuer à mieux distinguer les attentes et les usages des grands comptes des autres segments de clientèle
  • Faire remonter les besoins, attentes en cohérence avec les besoins du segment.
  • Contribuer à mieux distinguer les attentes et les usages des grands comptes des autres segments de clientèle
  • Faire remonter les besoins, attentes et évolutions du marché des grands cabinets

5. Coordonner les équipes internes

  • Coordonner la transmission des projets signés aux équipes Customer Success, Formation et Administration des Ventes.
  • Mobiliser les équipes Marketing, Produit et Technique autour des opportunités stratégiques.
  • Faciliter la circulation des informations entre les équipes en contact avec les grands comptes.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes et outils de vente Grands Comptes.

Qualifications

Ton profil

Tu justifies d’une expérience confirmée dans la vente de solutions SaaS B2B, idéalement auprès des cabinets d’expertise comptable. Ta connaissance de cet environnement et ta capacité à échanger avec des décideurs de haut niveau te permettent de porter une vision stratégique.

item.title: Lead Software Engineer at AAPC
item.description:
This is a remote position

The Opportunity

AAPC seeks a distinctive type of software engineer: someone who blends strong technical skills with curiosity, initiative, product insight, and a rare passion for delivering value. You will join an engineering team in AAPC’s Technology and Engineering organization that is focused on the marketing domain: our website, digital products, e-commerce, and the systems that take people from discovery through membership, certification, and renewal. You will work closely with Marketing, who will clarify the customer problem, its importance, and the business rules that guide the solution. You will be responsible for translating that guidance into functional technology that reaches users and delivers measurable benefits.

We want engineers who can move from understanding the “what” and “why” to figuring out the “how.” Analyze the problem, manage ambiguity, make sound technical choices, and execute effectively. You need to work quickly, exercise judgment, and own the process end to end.

You don’t need a marketing background. What matters is that you can connect systems reliably, build custom software where purchased tools fall short, and hold everything to the same production standard as the rest of our platform. You will partner with our platform engineering team on infrastructure, deployment, and observability, and with our data engineering team so member and customer data arrives complete and ready to use.

Modern tooling has fundamentally changed what an exceptional engineer can accomplish. In this role, you will treat AI as an extension of your engineering team. By leveraging agentic coding tools, reusable skills, agentic engineering practices, established components, and internal frameworks, you will orchestrate work that historically required a much larger team.

This is a hands-on lead role. You will be the most senior engineer on the team, setting standards, reviewing designs and code, and helping engineers with strong front-end and CMS skills grow into well-rounded engineers. From time to time, you will also step into interim team leadership to keep work moving.

What You’ll Do

  • Turn clearly articulated customer problems, business needs, and business rules into production-ready technology.
  • Own delivery of the software you build, from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, observability, support, and continuous improvement.
  • Break complex outcomes into executable work and coordinate agents toward a common goal.
  • Connect the platforms the business already uses through reliable integrations, and build custom services and customer-facing applications where those platforms fall short.
  • Work with platform engineering and data engineering so what you build runs on our standard infrastructure and member and customer data flows reliably into our data platform.
  • Investigate and resolve ambiguity independently when you can determine the answer through technical judgment, research, customer context, or existing standards.
  • Identify genuine business questions early and return them to Marketing or the responsible stakeholder quickly enough that answers don’t delay delivery.
  • Make technical decisions autonomously while remaining aligned with shared architectural principles, platforms, and standards.
  • Deliver valuable increments early, learn from real usage, and iterate rapidly.
  • Set standards, review designs and code, and mentor the engineers on your team.
  • Create and improve reusable skills, components, frameworks, workflows, and automation that increase the effectiveness of future engineering work.
  • Strengthen testing, code review, security analysis, accessibility, quality assurance, monitoring, and incident diagnosis.
  • Measure success by customer and business outcomes, not by the number of stories completed or the amount of code produced.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a recent record of writing and shipping production code yourself.
  • Demonstrated experience taking software from an initial idea through production delivery.
  • Practical experience across the broader technology lifecycle, including software development, deployment, DevOps, observability, monitoring, and production support.
  • Ability to work across technical boundaries rather than staying limited to one narrow layer of a system.
  • Experience integrating with third-party systems through APIs, webhooks, or events, and designing for the ways they fail.
  • Strong judgment about when to act independently, when to investigate further, and when a decision must return to the business or another responsible stakeholder.
  • Experience using agentic coding tools, or compelling evidence that you are actively developing an agentic engineering practice.
  • The ability to direct, evaluate, and integrate AI-generated work while retaining full accountability for its correctness and quality.
  • Experience leading technically: setting standards, reviewing code, and mentoring other engineers.
  • A history of learning unfamiliar technologies and applying them to real problems.
  • Clear, concise communication, especially when raising questions, explaining tradeoffs, or working asynchronously.
  • A customer-oriented mindset and an understanding that successful engineering creates customer and business value.
  • The initiative to improve the systems and processes around you rather than repeatedly working around the same problems.

Experience with marketing automation, CRM, headless CMS, customer data, or e-commerce platforms is helpful but not required.

We value demonstrated capability, judgment, and personal drive more than a particular title or traditional seniority level. We will level this role based on demonstrated capability, from senior through principal.

Show Us What Drives You

We want to know what you chose to build, not just what an employer assigned to you. We encourage you to share something that demonstrates your curiosity, initiative, and passion for the craft. The subject matter does not need to align with AAPC’s products. We are interested in what you chose to learn, the problems you encountered, the decisions you made, and whether you cared enough to bring the idea to life.

AAPC (www.aapc.com) is the world’s largest and fastest-growing healthcare training, certification, and solutions association.

AAPC Values:

DRIVEN | Self-starts and stays highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals. Shares contagious energy and enthusiasm liberally. Takes initiative without always being directed. Demonstrates confidence in decision-making and effectively balances autonomy and authority with accountability.

HUMBLE | Learns, adapts, and improves relentlessly. Seeks feedback without insecurity and implements coaching. Recognizes others’ contributions gratefully. Approaches work and relationships with an abundance mentality. Places the needs of others above self.

TRANSPARENT| Integrity-centered, honest, truthful, and trustworthy in all aspects of work. Keeps commitments to external and internal parties. Holds self strictly accountable, valuing the trust placed in them by others.

SUPPORTIVE | Empowers and uplifts others. Listens actively and responds with empathy and understanding. Prioritizes well-being and growth of team members and customers ahead of own interest. Faces challenges together, believing in collective strength and unity.

INNOVATIVE | Entrepreneurial spirit with a scrappy mentality. Dreams big, sees opportunity, pursues full potential, and finds ways to accomplish the impossible. Rolls up sleeves and does real work. Works quickly, intelligently, and flexibly.

What we Offer:

  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account
  • Generous PTO and Holiday Pay
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Remote/virtual-office consideration

AAPC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

This company is committed to fairness and equal opportunity in our hiring practices. We do not discriminate on grounds unrelated to a candidate’s ability to perform the duties of the job. Our focus is on finding the best person for each role, based on merit and fit, to ensure success both for our company and for the individual’s professional growth.

 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company does not and will not discriminate in employment and personnel practices on the basis of race, sex, age, disability, religion, national origin, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Hiring, transferring and promotion practices are performed without regard to the above-listed items.

AAPC uses artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tools in parts of our recruiting process for some positions. These tools may help us review and score responses to application questions against job-related criteria and prioritize applications for further review. Our recruiting team and hiring managers make all interview and hiring decisions, consistent with AAPC’s equal employment opportunity policies.

If you have questions about how AI is used in our hiring process or need a reasonable accommodation or an alternative way to be considered, please contact afi.malek@aapc.com. Asking will not negatively affect your application.

item.title: Senior Product Manager, IP & Location and Platform (APILayer) at IDERA Software
item.description:
We’re looking for a commercially minded Senior Product Manager who thinks in funnels, pricing and retention, not just features. You’ll own revenue for APILayer’s largest API group, led by ipstack, and the shared platform every APILayer API runs on. 

About APILayer 
APILayer, an Idera company, builds more than 20 APIs that developers use for IP geolocation, currency rates, market data, phone and email verification, aviation and weather data, and web scraping.  Customers buy through three storefronts: each API’s own site (such as ipstack.com and fixer.io), the APILayer Marketplace, and the new APILayer ecosystem, where one account buys many APIs.  We are organizing product and marketing into three growth pods: IP & Location, Finance, and Verification & Data. Each pod has a product manager who owns its revenue, a product marketing manager, and dedicated engineers. This role leads the IP & Location pod. 

What you’ll own: IP & Location 
You own revenue for six APIs: ipstack, ipapi, userstack, positionstack, countrylayer and zipcodebase. Together they serve a large, established customer base, and your mandate is to grow it: win more new customers while keeping the ones we have. 

  • Revenue: the full funnel from signup to paid, plus net revenue retention and churn
  • Roadmap and releases: a regular release cadence for each API
  • Packaging: free tiers, usage limits, pricing and upgrade triggers for each API
  • New customers: find and act on the biggest levers for winning new ipstack and ipapi customers
  • Portfolio: decide how ipstack and ipapi, which overlap, should be positioned or combined
  • Ecosystem move: move your API customers from their own sites to our new central ecosystem
  • Customer insight: talk to developers and buyers regularly through interviews, cancellation surveys and win/loss reviews
  • Hands-on: sign up for, integrate and use each API the way your customers do
  • Market: research competitors, and flag acquisition or partnership targets to the GM
  • Go-to-market: set positioning, messaging and conversion experiments with your product marketing manager Platform and back-end

You also own delivery of the shared platform behind all three storefronts: accounts, API keys, usage metering, plans and billing. Our architects own the technical design; you set priorities, scope the work, sequence it and clear blockers. 

  • Run the platform request queue for all three pods, and review priorities monthly with the GM
  • Keep free calls, limits and plans configurable, so PMs can change them without engineering work
  • Hold platform reliability: uptime, and metering and billing accuracy
  • Deliver the account and billing work for retiring the APILayer Marketplace and moving customers to the ecosystem
  • Keep the Finance and Verification & Data pod PMs informed of what is shipping and when

Must-have qualifications 
These are required; we screen on each one. 

  • 6+ years in product management, including 2+ years owning revenue for a self-serve product
  • Experience with developer products or APIs: you read API docs and talk architecture with engineers
  • Hands-on work with usage-based pricing, free tiers and self-serve signup funnels
  • Comfort with data: SQL or a BI tool, plus funnel and cohort analysis
  • Hands-on with how developers use AI to consume APIs: you prototype integrations yourself with AI coding assistants and agents (for example, through MCP servers) to shape how our APIs are  discovered and used, and you use AI in your own research and analysis
  • A record of shipping on a regular cadence with a dedicated engineering team
  • Influence without authority: you can get other pods, architects and marketing to agree on one set of priorities
  • Experience working with international teams across several time zones
  • Clear, concise writing, since much of the work runs asynchronously across time zones

Important qualifications 
Strong candidates will have several of these; none is required on its own. 

  • Prioritizing shared platform work across several product teams
  • Experience with Stripe or similar billing and usage-metering systems
  • Search-led customer acquisition for developer products
  • Moving customers from one platform or storefront to another
  • Project management or agile delivery experience
  • Managing a portfolio of several product brands

 

An Equal Opportunity Employer - All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Idera, Inc. will process and retain your resume and related personal information solely for recruitment and hiring purposes. Resumes of unsuccessful candidates will be securely deleted within twelve (12) months of the hiring decision, unless a longer period is required by law or you provide explicit consent for continued retention (e.g., for consideration for future opportunities).

In compliance with applicable privacy laws, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting  [email protected]. Idera, Inc. does not sell candidate data and will ensure that all personal information is processed securely and in accordance with relevant data protection regulations.

An Equal Opportunity Employer - All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

item.title: Employment Paralegal - 1147 at Quantinuum
item.description:
We are seeking an Employment Paralegal in our Broomfield, CO Location.

 

Quantinuum believes that employees work better, more efficiently and more collaboratively in close proximity to other employees, where ideas can be exchanged readily, and decisions can be made more quickly for the benefit of the Company and our customers. All employees should work at their assigned location; however, this role may offer the opportunity to work remotely up to 2 days per week, with approvals.

 

This is a lead paralegal role within the Legal & Compliance Operations team, focused on employment compliance, workforce regulatory matters and employment legal operations. The role will work closely with and provide senior-level specialist support to Quantinuum’s VP Legal, Employment across the full range of employment workstreams. These include employment documentation and policies, statutory and regulatory compliance, workplace investigations and employment dispute support, immigration and right-to-work processes, benefits and equity administration support, employee data privacy, export control screening for new hires, employee representative matters and workforce changes. This support covers the US, UK, Germany, Japan, Singapore and the Middle East.

 

The Lead Employment Paralegal will act as a senior subject-matter resource for employment compliance matters. The role will independently lead complex workstreams, establish and improve employment compliance processes and standards, and provide guidance to HR, Operations teams and other legal team members.

 

The role will exercise significant judgment in identifying employment and workforce compliance risks. It will determine appropriate approaches within established legal frameworks and company policies and escalate matters requiring legal interpretation or counsel appropriately. Working across Legal, HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Trade Compliance and senior leadership stakeholders, the role will help ensure that employment compliance practices remain effective, scalable and aligned with organizational requirements across all jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end coordination, tracking and timely delivery of employment compliance deliverables across all jurisdictions. These include government and workforce reporting, statutory notices, registrations and required filings, and the work must stay aligned with legal requirements and internal timelines.
  • Prepare first drafts of routine and moderately complex employment documents, including offer letters, employment agreements, contractor agreements, separation agreements, policies, and handbooks. Provide specialist input on jurisdiction-specific employment requirements and escalate matters requiring substantive legal interpretation.
  • Manage the global employment compliance calendar, including reporting deadlines, policy review cycles, mandatory training, workplace posting requirements and visa and work permit expirations. Proactively coordinate inputs from internal stakeholders and establish controls and processes that reduce compliance risk.
  • Monitor employment law and regulatory developments across all jurisdictions. Assess their potential impact on established employment policies, documentation and compliance processes, and recommend procedural or operational changes to the VP Legal, Employment.
  • Lead end-to-end support for workplace investigations and employment disputes. This includes matter intake, document collection, chronologies, litigation holds, responses to agency charges and coordination with outside counsel, establishing consistent standards across the investigation and dispute lifecycle.
  • Draft and maintain high-quality investigation records, matter files and employment legal documentation. Ensure timely follow-up on remedial and corrective actions and provide guidance on documentation standards and established practices.
  • Coordinate immigration and right-to-work processes, including visa and work permit applications, renewals and right-to-work verification, working with immigration counsel and HR. Coordinate with Trade Compliance on export control screening for new hires, applying processes consistently across all relevant entities.
  • Lead the operational employment compliance framework across global entities. This includes jurisdiction-specific employment templates, mandatory policies, employee representative processes, and workforce changes such as reductions in force, transfers, and restructurings. Work with local counsel and internal stakeholders to identify and address employment risks.
  • Support the legal aspects of benefits and equity administration, including review of plan documents, equity grant documentation and plan compliance, coordinating with Total Rewards, Payroll and Finance.
  • Support employee data privacy compliance, including employee privacy notices, data subject access requests, records retention and cross-border transfers of employee data, working with the Privacy team.
  • Manage and enhance employment legal records and matter management systems, ensuring data accuracy and producing regular reporting. Set data and process improvements, and coordinate with external advisers, counsel, employer of record providers and auditors.
  • Act as a key subject-matter resource for employment compliance operations, providing guidance to Legal colleagues, HR and business stakeholders on established requirements, processes and practices.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives across employment compliance, investigations and workforce operations, establishing scalable processes, controls, templates, playbooks and operating procedures.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to paralegals and other Legal Operations colleagues on employment compliance processes, supporting consistent standards and developing capability across the team.
  • Beyond employment matters, the role will help build Quantinuum’s wider litigation and disputes capability across all practice areas and jurisdictions. This role will lead the design and implementation of litigation management processes, including matter intake, triage, the litigation hold process, status reporting and closure, working with the VP Legal, Employment other Legal team members, and with IT, Information Security, and the applicable business unit to preserve relevant data. This role will also coordinate responses to subpoenas, third-party information requests and regulatory or agency inquiries, escalating matters requiring legal judgement.

YOU MUST HAVE:

  • Bachelors degree minimum
  • 8+ years’ experience in an employment or employment compliance paralegal role, in-house or at a law firm. This must include deep practical knowledge of US employment compliance requirements and at least one other jurisdiction where Quantinuum operates.
  • Due to Contractual requirements, must be a U.S. Person defined as, U.S. citizen permanent resident or green card holder, workers granted asylum or refugee status

WE VALUE:

  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex employment compliance, workplace investigation or employment dispute workstreams in a multinational or similarly regulated environment.
  • Strong practical expertise in employment documentation, workplace policies, statutory compliance, immigration and multi-jurisdictional workforce matters.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify employment and workforce risks, assess their operational implications, recommend appropriate actions and recognize when matters require escalation to legal counsel.
  • Experience establishing or significantly improving employment compliance processes, controls, templates, playbooks or operating procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional work involving senior stakeholders, specialist advisers and multiple competing deadlines without formal authority.
  • Strong drafting, research and organizational skills, including experience preparing sophisticated first drafts of employment agreements, policies and investigation documentation.
  • Experience maintaining employment records and documentation across multiple jurisdictions, including handling confidential and sensitive employee information.
  • Confident communicating with HR, managers, employee representatives, immigration providers and external advisers on routine matters.
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms, matter management and e-discovery tools, and standard legal technology tools. This includes experience implementing improvements, automation or more effective use of legal technology.
  • Experience supporting employment compliance through significant organizational events, such as reductions in force, acquisitions and integrations, restructuring, international expansion or periods of rapid growth.
  • Experience developing employment compliance reporting, controls, metrics or monitoring frameworks.
  • Experience leading employment process-improvement or legal-operations initiatives involving multiple jurisdictions and stakeholders.
  • Exposure to export control screening in hiring, and interest in or exposure to the emerging technology sector.

$108,000 - $145,000 a year

This position is Bonus and Equity Eligible

The base pay range for this role is $108,000 – $145,000 annually. Actual compensation within this range may vary based on the candidate’s skills, educational background, professional experience, and unique qualifications for the role.

Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing. 

Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world’s leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master’s or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore. 

By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.

What’s in it for you?

We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success.

  • Competitive compensation and the opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology
  • Flexible work arrangements that support work-life balance
  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match and student loan repayment benefit
  • Equity opportunities
  • Generous paid time off, sick leave, and 12 paid holidays annually
  • Paid parental leave
  • Employee discount programs

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Quantinuum is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on job-related qualifications and business needs, without regard to race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, age, physical or mental disability, serious medical condition, genetic information, marital status, spousal affiliation, military status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Consideration of citizenship or immigration status is limited to cases where a law, regulation, executive order, or government contract requires it. 

Quantinuum is a federal contractor and provides equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. 

We provide reasonable accommodations for disabilities, serious medical conditions, pregnancy-related needs, and sincerely held religious beliefs. To request an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process, contact [email/link]. 

Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal. [https://www.eeoc.gov/poster] 

Export Control Notice (U.S. Positions) 

Some Quantinuum positions involve access to technology or software subject to U.S. export control laws, including the Export Administration Regulations. For these positions, Quantinuum may need to obtain U.S. government authorization, such as an export license, before a candidate who is not a “U.S. person” can access controlled technology. “U.S. persons” include U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, and individuals granted asylum or refugee status. Quantinuum may ask candidates for information needed to determine whether authorization is required. Any hiring decision on this basis will turn on whether required authorization can be obtained. Quantinuum does not otherwise consider citizenship, immigration status, or national origin. 

We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know use the Lets talk contact form. 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, there is no application deadline for this position.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know use the Lets talk contact form.

item.title: Backend Engineer (Scala) - Identity & Access Management (IDAM) at METRO AG
item.description:
Company Description

About us:   

Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.   

Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.    

You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!   

How you will make an impact?  

As a Backend Engineer (Scala) in the Identity and Access Management (IDAM) squad within the Cyber Security platform at METRO Digital, you will be at the heart of the systems that govern who can access what across our global retail organisation. Your work directly secures and enables the digital identity of tens of thousands of customers and systems. You will design, build, and maintain high-performance backend services written in Scala, operating on top of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ensuring reliability, scalability, and security at every layer.

Please note that this role is open also for candidates in Brasov and Cluj.

Job Description

Your Responsibilities:  

  • Design, develop, and maintain Scala-based backend services handling identity governance, provisioning workflows, and access management logic;
  • Collaborate closely with the IDAM squad to implement and evolve core platform capabilities: role assignments, entitlement management, and lifecycle automation;
  • Work on data persistence layers using PostgreSQL— ensuring correctness, performance, and resilience;
  • Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes; contribute to reliability, observability, and on-call readiness;
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture decisions within the squad
  • Split large initiatives into small, manageable microservices and subprojects;
  • Work in an Agile/Scrum environment with short delivery cycles and close collaboration with product and security stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required key competencies and qualifications: 

  • Good knowledge in Java/Scala (5+ years of experience);
  • Enthusiasm for automating and automatically scaling tests and deployments with Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and knowledge of IaC (Terraform);
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases — PostgreSQL;
  • Security mindset when designing and building applications;
  • Interest in splitting large projects into small, manageable microservices;
  • Ability to communicate fluently in English (written and verbal);
  • Curiosity and drive to constantly learn and adopt new technologies.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with Datadog and the Play Framework;
  • Hands-on experience with secure authentication and authorisation mechanisms: JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and role-based access control (RBAC);
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar);
  • CI/CD pipeline experience and DevOps practices.

Additional Information

What we offer at METRO.digital?    

  • Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.

At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.

  • People development: when you grow so do we!

We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation … it´s time to upskill your career.

  • Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!

We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.

Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here. 

Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!    

Position grade within our career framework: Full Stack Engineer Grade 3 (Md7).

item.title: Contract AP Chemistry Teacher - Curriculum Developer at UWorld
item.description:
UWorld is seeking an experienced AP Chemistry teacher to join our team as a remote content author, contributing to our web-based Advanced Placement study materials.  In this role, you’ll work closely with UWorld’s internal content development team to create rigorous, student-centered AP Chemistry preparation resources including multiple-choice questions and free-response questions aligned to the current AP Chemistry course framework and supporting instructional content.  This is an opportunity to apply your classroom expertise at scale and help students across the country succeed on one of the most popular AP exams.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in education required, a degree in Chemistry is preferred

Minimum Required Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience teaching AP Chemistry in high school
  • Two years of experience writing assessment questions (eg, classroom exams, labs) at the level of the AP Chemistry examination
  • Experience being an AP Reader, AP Table Leader, or AP Consultant in Chemistry is a strong plus

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Deep familiarity with the AP Chemistry course framework, including the current exam format (MCQ, AAQ, and EBQ question types
  • Proven ability to write high-quality AP Chemistry FRQs with accurate, detailed scoring rubrics

  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills

Job Responsibilities:
