item.title: Analytics Engineer at Omnidian
item.description:
About Omnidian

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries.  Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience.

We are a certified B Corp that formed in the US in 2016 and have been growing globally since then. We expanded to Australia in 2022, acquired Solar Service Guys in Australia in 2025, and have opened up a new talent hub in India in 2026. Be part of the “First Wave” experience! You would be a founding member of our India team, helping us build a brand-new hub from the ground up. 

The Job

The Analytics Engineer will build and maintain the data pipelines behind Omnidian’s performance and financial reporting. Our platform is moving away from API-driven workflows toward set-based, SQL-first pipelines, and this role sits at the center of that shift.

This role is roughly 80% data and 20% backend engineering. Most of your time goes to SQL transformations and data modeling, done with software engineering habits: testing, versioning, code review, and clean deployments. The team is upstream of most of the company’s data, so your work reaches Finance, Operations, Product, and leadership reporting.

What You’ll Do

At Omnidian we believe in trust and autonomy. How you create an impact is ultimately up to you. Here is an outline of some of the things you’ll be doing:

Pipeline Development & Migration (50%)

  • Migrate existing pipelines and reports to our new reporting architecture with little or no noticeable impact to the people who rely on them.
  • Build simple, scalable data pipelines in SQL and Python that the next engineer can maintain long after you’ve moved on.
  • Write tests, version your work, and follow sound deployment practices.
  • Use AI coding assistants as a core part of daily development to ship pipelines, tests, and documentation faster, while owning and understanding every line you commit. Help set the team’s standards for AI-assisted development: review practices, guardrails, and reusable prompts and workflows.

Platform Ownership & Optimization (30%)

  • Learn the wider data platform on your own: where data lives, who consumes it, and how other teams’ changes affect yours, including reading their pull requests.
  • Spot performance and cost problems in a design before they ship.
  • Recommend the simplest tool that solves the problem, and help retire tools that no longer fit.

Cross-Team Collaboration (20%)

  • Work directly with Product, Operations, Finance, and Legal to understand their needs and find new places the team can help.
  • Communicate clearly in your own words, showing real understanding of the work.
  • Adapt as priorities shift, and keep momentum when plans change.

Who You Are

  • A hybrid of analytics and engineering: strong in data, comfortable with backend development. Not only a report writer, and not only an application developer.
  • Independent. You look for room to improve without being asked, keep up with what’s happening across the department, and aren’t afraid to suggest a simpler way of doing things.
  • A communicator beyond engineering. You engage in good faith with non-technical teams, and you know those relationships are where the most valuable work comes from.
  • Platform agnostic. You choose tools because they solve a real problem, not out of habit.
  • AI-forward and disciplined. AI is central to how you build, and you hold its output to the same bar as your own work: small, readable, tested changes you can explain line by line. Your written communication reflects your own understanding, not pasted AI output.
  • Calm under change. You stay productive and positive when plans shift.

Experience You’ll Need

  • 7+ years in a data engineering or analytics engineering role, building and supporting production data pipelines.
  • 7+ years of advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, incremental models, query tuning) on a cloud warehouse or lakehouse: Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of Python for data work, including PySpark, pandas, or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of backend development in a typed language and framework, such as Java or Kotlin with Spring Boot, Python with type hints and FastAPI, TypeScript with Node, or equivalent.
  • Hands-on testing experience with pytest, JUnit, dbt tests, or equivalent. You write tests as part of the work, not after it.
  • Git-based development with pull request review and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, or equivalent), including versioned, repeatable deployments.
  • 1+ year of AI-assisted development as a daily practice, using Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. You can show concrete examples where AI sped up delivery without lowering code quality.
  • Senior-level ownership: you’ve set technical direction for a pipeline or platform area, reviewed others’ code, and mentored less experienced engineers.
  • Led at least two platform migrations end to end (for example a warehouse, ETL tool, or BI platform move) with minimal disruption to downstream users.
  • Practical platform administration: cluster and warehouse sizing, partitioning, query profiling, and cost monitoring. You can explain a time you prevented a performance or cost problem before it shipped.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience That’s a Plus

  • Building with LLM APIs or agent tooling, such as MCP servers, text-to-SQL, or AI-powered data quality and reporting features.
  • Production experience with dbt (Core or Cloud) or Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables).
  • Databricks specifically: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows.
  • Data quality frameworks such as DQX, Great Expectations, Soda, or equivalent.
  • Orchestration with Airflow, Dagster, Databricks Workflows, or equivalent.
  • Ingestion from SaaS APIs and tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, or custom connectors.
  • Business systems data, especially Salesforce and NetSuite.
  • BI tools such as Sigma, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform or equivalent.
  • Experience in renewable energy, solar, or IoT and device telemetry data.

Culture & Benefits

  • We offer a competitive total compensation package bonuses and long-term stock options so you can share in the long-term value you help create as we shape the future together..
  • We offer a competitive benefits program for our employees and their dependents, including medical, dental, vision
  • We are a passionate, mission driven team that believes in collaboration, mutual respect and trust. For examples, come Discover our Story!

$22,500 - $37,500 a year

Our Philosophy on Pay: The range listed above reflects the starting base salary for most new hires in this role. However, your financial growth doesn’t stop at the offer letter. We invest deeply in our people and reward results; annual merit increases can bring your total compensation above this initial range. Our goal is for you to continue growing within the pay band as you sharpen your skills and drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Committed to Parity: We eliminate the “negotiation tax” by placing candidates within the band based on verified professional experience and skill set, not bartering ability, and by giving our best offer up front. This is a core part of our mission to ensure gender pay equity and fairness across the board.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Your well-being is our priority. We cover 100% of health insurance monthly premiums for employees and 50% for your dependents.
  • Performance Bonus: Exceptional work deserves exceptional rewards. You’ll be eligible for bonuses that reflect your contributions to our collective success.
  • Equity Stake: We offer stock options so you can share in the long-term value you help create as we shape the future together.
  • Continuous Growth: We are a learning organization. To support your evolution, we provide up to $500 in annual learning reimbursement for courses, certifications, or conferences.

Diversity and Inclusion

We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our customers. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value diversity and inclusion and are committed to ensuring our hiring and retention practices, as well as our office culture, reflects this value.

 

_We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation._ 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

item.title: Sr. Staff Forward Deployed Engineer at Databricks
item.description:
CSQ128R208

PLEASE NOTE: Due to federal contract requirements and client site access obligations, U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a U.S. government secret clearance are required to access classified information. Candidates with an active Secret or higher clearance are strongly encouraged to apply.

About Databricks: At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world’s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers and deeply customer-obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve hard technical challenges, from designing modern application interfaces to architecting highly available, distributed systems at massive scale. And we’re only getting started.

The Role:As a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will be the principal technical authority working with our largest and most complex federal government customers to solve their most critical software, data, and AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will define the technical vision, pioneer novel system architectures, and lead the implementation of enterprise-scale applications spanning backend infrastructure, API integration, and AI-powered product development.

At the Senior Staff level, you are a force multiplier. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering leadership, product management, and developer relations. You will act as a trusted advisor to technical executives at customer organizations, integrating deeply with client codebases and systems while mentoring other FDEs and engineering teams. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for elite builders and technical strategists who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, distributed systems, and massive business impact.

Please note: this role is hybrid and has a requirement to travel to customer locations 20-25% of the time.

The impact you will have:

  • Strategic Solution Leadership: Lead the most complex and high-stakes customer technical projects. Pioneer and build robust, first-of-their-kind reference architectures, massive-scale custom enterprise applications, and seamless integrations with cutting-edge AI/ML models.
  • Enterprise Transformation: Drive executive-level technical strategy as strategic customers implement transformational software projects. Oversee the end-to-end design, build, and deployment of industry-leading, data-intensive AI applications across highly matrixed federal organizations.
  • Visionary Guidance: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. Guide technical leadership on software architecture, system design, and platform adoption, successfully steering their long-term Databricks development strategy.
  • Architectural Pioneer: Own and define software architecture decisions for systems with unprecedented scale or security requirements. Ensure applications are secure, highly available, scalable, and set the standard for modern software engineering and Databricks best practices globally.
  • Deliver Technical Excellence: Orchestrate multi-team, multi-quarter technical engagements. Align Databricks technical teams, Architects, and Customer engineering leadership to ensure flawless delivery of mission-critical software components.
  • Product Engineering Influence: Partner heavily with Databricks Core Engineering and Product leadership. Translate complex, edge-case developer challenges from the field into actionable product roadmap initiatives, APIs, and platform enhancements.
  • Customer Immersion & Navigation: Embed with customer engineering teams, navigating highly complex organizational structures to deeply understand entrenched software challenges and deliver code-level, systemic impact.
  • Ecosystem Multiplication: Act as a technical multiplier. Pioneer and open-source massive-scale code accelerators, global development frameworks, and engineering best practices that scale impact across all federal accounts and elevate the entire FDE organization.

What We’re Looking For:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, or distributed systems engineering, with a proven track record of architectural leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent relevant years of experience in an Engineering function.
  • Expert-level proficiency writing scalable production code in Python, Scala, Java, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and architecting solutions using modern application frameworks.
  • Deep, authoritative multi-cloud architectural expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP) with the ability to design cross-cloud or hybrid distributed systems.
  • Advanced experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and deep internal knowledge of the Spark runtime engine, optimization, and scaling.
  • Mastery of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform) for complex, high-security production deployments.
  • Expert knowledge of MLOps, deploying custom ML/AI models, and integrating LLMs and AI APIs into massive-scale production environments.
  • Proven ability to design and deploy performant, end-to-end software architectures that combine backend services, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces with zero-downtime requirements.
  • Extensive experience steering complex technical project delivery—managing massive scope, driving agile engineering teams, and translating ambiguous business requirements into actionable, enterprise-grade software solutions.
  • Exceptional technical documentation, system white-boarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex distributed systems to both elite engineers and non-technical executives.
  • Deep experience working with massive enterprise or federal clients, managing conflicts, and driving consensus across a highly diverse and senior stakeholder range.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, continuously explore new development tools, and push the boundaries of what is possible with Databricks-based solutions.
  • Travel to customers 20-25% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, and building mission-critical, enterprise-level distributed systems.
  • Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., published papers, tech blog posts, open-source maintainer status, or conference speaking experience).
  • Experience serving on an enterprise architecture board or steering committee.
  • Certification in a Databricks-specific domain.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer’s discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

item.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager at Ivalua
item.description:
SR PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER 

(Massy- France)

ABOUT IVALUA: 

At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration. 

We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world’s most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities. 

Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn

THE OPPORTUNITY

CONTEXT: 

Ivalua is a leading Source-to-Pay platform used by roughly 600 enterprise customers to manage spend, suppliers, contracts and procurement across the full S2P lifecycle. We are in the middle of the biggest product shift in our history. IVA, our fully agentic AI, runs inside the platform with full access to customer data and governed by each user’s permissions. IVA Studio gives customers the engine and control tower to build, govern and extend Skills, tools and agents. Both sit on a single-platform architecture that is the reason the AI works.

The market is crowded with AI claims. We need someone who can tell the story in plain language, prove it with customers, and equip every seller and partner to tell it the same way.

ROLE: 

You will own product marketing for Ivalua’s AI and platform, end to end. That covers IVA, IVA Studio and the unified platform they run on: positioning, messaging, launches, pricing and packaging input, competitive intelligence, enablement, customer proof and adoption, plus evangelism of Ivalua’s AI story with analysts and influencers. You are the go-to expert on how the platform, the models and the governance layer fit together, and you turn that depth into a story a CPO, a CIO and a seller can all repeat.

You are also the architect of AI-augmented product marketing at Ivalua. You will build the workflows, agents and Skills that let a focused team produce more, faster and at higher quality, and you will show the rest of the organization how it is done. This is a senior role with real scope and direct access to leadership. You will work daily with Product, R&D, Sales, Customer Success, the field and our partners, and you will set the standard for how Ivalua brings AI to market.

WHAT YOU WILL DO WITH US 

1. Storytelling, positioning and messaging

  • Own the positioning and messaging architecture for IVA, IVA Studio and the Ivalua platform, and keep it consistent across web, sales material, events, analyst and influencer conversations and customer communications.
  • Take complex topics (agentic architecture, Skills, MCP, LLM choice and BYOLLM, governance, permissions, data models) and simplify them for buyers. Turn them into relevant, engaging stories they remember and repeat: customer-first narratives, sharp analogies, demo storylines and executive talk tracks.
  • Define how Ivalua talks about agentic AI in procurement and why a unified data model and architecture matter for AI outcomes.
  • Maintain messaging by persona across procurement, supply chain, IT, finance and legal buying groups, with a particular focus on CIO and IT audiences.

2. AI-augmented PMM workflows

  • Design and run an AI-augmented PMM operating model. Use AI agents and Skills across research, competitive intelligence, messaging drafts, enablement production, launch planning and reporting, with human judgment on strategy, narrative and quality.
  • Build reusable workflows, prompts and Skills that shrink the time from product announcement to a complete GTM package: battlecard, talk tracks, one-pager, demo storyline and FAQ.
  • Set the standards for review, accuracy and governance of AI-generated content, so everything that reaches the market is on-brand, correct and approved.
  • Use Ivalua’s own AI where it fits and share what works, so the team and cross-functional partners learn to work the same way.
  • Measure the gain in speed, output quality, field usage and pipeline influence, and keep improving the system.

3. Launches and go-to-market

  • Lead tiered launch plans for AI and platform releases, from launch brief through enablement, content, briefings, campaigns and pipeline measurement.
  • Partner with Product on roadmap, release priorities and go-to-market requirements, and act as the voice of the market and customer in those decisions.
  • Provide input on pricing, packaging and consumption models, including IVA Credits and how AI value is communicated commercially.
  • Work with Demand Generation, Content, Events and Communications to turn launch narratives into integrated campaigns.

4. Sales, partner and customer enablement

  • Build the assets the field needs to win: pitch decks, talk tracks, demo storylines, battlecards, discovery guides, ROI frameworks, RFP boilerplate and objection handling.
  • Run enablement for AEs, solution consultants, CSMs and SI partners, including training, certification content and regular release readiness.
  • Work with Solution Consulting to shape demos that show AI and platform value through real use cases, not feature tours.

5. Competitive and market intelligence

  • Monitor the fast-moving agentic AI landscape, including S2P competitors, AI-native entrants and horizontal AI platforms, and turn shifts into concrete guidance for sellers and leadership.
  • Run win/loss and customer research to sharpen positioning and find proof points.
  • Maintain a living view of where Ivalua is differentiated and where it needs to improve.

6. Market evangelism and thought leadership

  • Evangelize Ivalua’s AI story in the market. Brief and build lasting relationships with the analysts and influencers who shape procurement and AI buying decisions, give them access to product and customers, and equip them to tell the story in their own voice.
  • Create thought leadership with executives: blogs, whitepapers, keynotes, webinars and press support that take a clear point of view on agentic AI in procurement.
  • Be a visible voice at customer and industry events, on panels and in the social conversation.

7. Customer proof and adoption

  • Build a steady pipeline of customer stories, quantified outcomes and reference programs for AI and platform, working with Customer Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Partner with Customer Success on adoption messaging and plays for expansion into IVA and IVA Studio across the install base.
  • Capture the Skills and use cases customers build and turn them into reusable proof.

 

YOUR PROFILE

If you have the below experience and strengths, this role could be for you:

Required Experience

  • 8+ years of B2B SaaS or enterprise software product marketing, with a proven record owning positioning, launches and enablement for a platform or multi-product portfolio.
  • A masterful storyteller. You take complex topics and simplify them for buyers, turning them into relevant, engaging stories that people remember and retell. You lead with the idea, cut the filler and can show work that proves it.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-augmented PMM workflows, using AI tools and agents for research, competitive analysis, content and enablement, with the judgment to know what to automate and what to keep human.
  • Direct experience marketing AI or agentic products to enterprise buyers, with examples of campaigns, launches or narratives you shaped.
  • Enough technical depth to be credible with architects, CIOs and engineers on topics like LLMs, agents, retrieval, MCP and AI governance.
  • Experience marketing to both IT and line-of-business audiences in long, multi-stakeholder, sales-led enterprise cycles.
  • Comfort evangelizing a product with analysts, influencers, media and customers, in writing and on stage.
  • A track record of building sales enablement that gets used: battlecards, playbooks, demo narratives, ROI tools.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can set direction without waiting for a finished spec.
  • Fluent in both French and English, written and spoken (required if the role is based in France).
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business or a related field.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in procurement, Source-to-Pay, supply chain, finance or other enterprise business applications.
  • Experience building credibility with industry analysts and influencers.
  • Experience with pricing and packaging or consumption-based models for AI.
  • Experience inside an AI-native or platform company that moved from feature-led to AI-led product experiences.
  • Experience working with partners, systems integrators and field teams across regions.

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

If your application fits this specific position’s needs, our skilled Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial screening call. Get one step closer to achieving your goals – apply today! 

Our Talent team will guide you through every step of the interview process - from preparation to completion. They’re here to support you! 

Our recruitment process is designed to assess your competencies through a series of personalised interviews with internal stakeholders relevant to the role. 

Interviews will be conducted virtually via video or on-site with face-to-face meetings.

LIFE AT IVALUA

  • Hybrid working model (3 days in the office per week)
  • We’re a team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of product innovation and technology
  • Sustainable Growth, Privately Held
  • A stable and cash-flow positive Company since 10 years
  • Snacks and weekly lunches in the office
  • Feel empowered to pursue your goals with improved team collaboration and increased creativity/productivity
  • Unlock and unleash your full professional potential with our exceptional training and career development program
  • Join a dynamic and international team of top-notch professionals who are experts in their respective fields. Collaborate with like-minded individuals who are deeply passionate and highly motivated about their work. Experience a truly diverse and inclusive work environment where your unique contributions are highly valued
  • Regular social events, competitive outings, team running events, and musical activities
  • Comparably recognized Ivalua for the following (https://www.comparably.com/companies/ivalua):

 

Powered by People - Powered by You!

United by our values we embrace diversity and equity in the broadest possible sense to create an inclusive workplace. To help our customers make supply chains more efficient, sustainable and resilient, we rely on a global team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. We believe in equal opportunity and in diversity as a driver of innovation that cultivates a spirit of inclusiveness, creates a productive and fun place to work, and provides fulfilling career opportunities for all Ivaluans. https://www.linkedin.com/company/ivalua/about/

Experience life at Ivalua - check out our captivating video! Gain insight into our unique company culture and get a glimpse of what it’s like to work with us.

item.title: Regional Sales Director, Southwestern US at Astronomer
item.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io.

About this role:

We’re actively seeking a Regional Sales Director to lead our Enterprise AE team in the Southwestern US. This is a first-line leadership role where you’ll guide a team of talented sellers through complex, multi-stakeholder platform deals with enterprise accounts >1000 employees. This role is critical to Astronomer’s next stage of growth, shaping territory strategy, strengthening team performance, and turning our product strength into repeatable, high-quality revenue.

You’ll be hands-on as a coach and builder: mentoring Enterprise AEs, developing rising talent, and creating a culture where collaboration, resilience, and execution go hand in hand. The ideal candidate has either led enterprise sellers or been a successful enterprise seller themselves in recent years, with experience in high-growth environments and the confidence to navigate multi-threaded, complex evaluations.

Impact in this seat is clear: build a healthy, scalable enterprise motion in the Southwest, raise our win rates, shorten cycles, and set the standard for how we engage enterprise customers.

Location: This is a remote based position requiring periodic travel. We will consider qualified individuals based in Southern California. Relocation assistance is not offered at this time.

 

What you get to do:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Enterprise AEs.
  • Shape go-to-market strategy: territory planning, outbound and ABM campaigns, multi-threaded exec alignment, value articulation, and close plans.
  • Run a disciplined operating rhythm: 1:1s, pipeline reviews, forecast calls, quarterly business reviews, and consistent coaching moments.
  • Design and execute winning strategies for complex platform sales, aligning SE, Product, and Partnerships to accelerate deals.
  • Hire top talent, keep a strong bench in play, and partner with Recruiting to build a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team.
  • Drive pipeline standards and forecast accuracy, ensuring coverage, velocity, and reliable outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on targeted programs and with CS on expansion strategies to grow NRR and land-and-expand impact.
  • Represent the business to executive leadership with data-backed insights, risks, and recommendations.

 

What you bring to the role:

  • 5+ years leading first-line Enterprise AE teams with consistent quota attainment.
  • Mastery of enterprise methodologies such as MEDDIC, Command of the Message, or similar.
  • A builder mindset, with experience thriving in high-growth and smaller company settings, not only large incumbents.
  • Strength in executive storytelling, platform selling, and orchestrating technical + business stakeholders.
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a track record of helping sellers grow through feedback, mentorship, and clear standards.
  • A data-driven approach to pipeline management and forecasting, with rigor around hygiene, coverage, and stage progression.
  • Strong judgment on talent and culture fit, consistently raising the bar while supporting team stability.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and communication across customers, peers, and executives.

 

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience selling complex platforms in data, DevOps, infra, or adjacent enterprise SaaS categories.
  • A mix of startup or scaleup and larger-company experience, with small-org exposure in the last two roles.
  • Experience building regional playbooks, including territory design and ABM co-motion with Marketing.
  • A track record of hiring and onboarding diverse enterprise sellers, fostering inclusion, and building a performance-driven, supportive culture.

 

The estimated OTE for this role ranges from $425,000 - $450,000, along with an equity component. This range is merely an estimate, and the width of the range reflects willingness to consider candidates with broad prior seniority. Actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

 

#LI-Remote

 

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

item.title: Senior Director, Ecosystem Strategy and Programs at Astronomer
item.description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io.

Astronomer is investing in a global ecosystem that helps customers get more value from Astro and helps our partners grow their businesses with us. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Ecosystem Strategy and Programs to build the strategy, solutions, growth, and intelligence capabilities that will scale this business.

The initial focus is establishing these high leverage growth Partner Programs in accordance with a defined and targeted Partner Strategy. This includes setting strategy and business plans, building partner solutions and technical enablement, creating partner-led and product-led growth programs, and developing the intelligence, tools, automation, and AI that improve decisions and execution. You’ll stay close to partners and opportunities as you build repeatable systems for onboarding, joint go-to-market, customer adoption, and expansion.

This role reports to the Vice President of Global Partner Ecosystem and is suited to a strategic, hands-on leader who can move between executive alignment, program design, and practical execution.

Location: Remote-based / Hybrid in NYC or San Francisco Bay Area

As Senior Director, Ecosystem Strategy and Programs, you’ll get to:

  • Set the ecosystem strategy and program architecture: Define partner segments, priorities, engagement models, program principles, and the partner journey from recruitment and onboarding through activation, growth, and renewal.
  • Lead ecosystem and GTM business planning: Identify the partners, markets, solutions, and programs with the greatest growth potential, translate priorities into plans, and drive cross-functional execution.
  • Build programs around shared customer outcomes: Create clear participation paths, value propositions, requirements, benefits, and success measures for technology, cloud, services, and strategic partners.
  • Make partner economics work: Develop scalable approaches to partner incentives, co-investment, marketplace motions, and joint business planning in partnership with Finance and Sales leadership.
  • Turn partnerships into pipeline and adoption: Establish repeatable co-sell, referral, solution development, and customer expansion motions with clear ownership, qualification, handoffs, and feedback loops.
  • Build partner solutions capabilities: Lead partner solution architecture, technical onboarding and enablement, integrations, and joint solution development. Help partners position, integrate, and deliver Astronomer, and connect partner-led opportunities with the right technical resources.
  • Equip partners to reach the market: Work with Marketing and Sales to develop partner messaging, campaigns, events, solution briefs, case studies, and field enablement that generate demand and improve deal execution.
  • Accelerate ecosystem and product-led growth: Develop programs across acquisition, activation, lifecycle engagement, adoption, consumption growth, retention, and expansion in partnership with Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Create a consistent partner experience: Simplify program requirements, onboarding, enablement, partner communications, and internal processes so partners can focus on customers and growth.
  • Build the operating system for the ecosystem: Own program governance, planning cadences, partner business reviews, performance reporting, and cross-functional accountability.
  • Develop ecosystem intelligence and AI capabilities: Build business intelligence, ecosystem analytics, customer insights, enabling tools, and automation. Use data and AI to surface growth opportunities, improve decision quality, and increase GTM productivity.
  • Expand shared GTM support as the ecosystem scales: Apply proven strategy, growth, and intelligence capabilities to cross-functional GTM priorities, including customer growth and retention initiatives and AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Measure business outcomes: Track partner-sourced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline and revenue, partner onboarding and productivity, acquisition and activation, customer adoption, consumption, retention and expansion, and the impact of shared GTM programs.
  • Represent Astronomer with partners and the industry: Build trusted executive relationships and communicate a compelling vision for how partners can grow alongside Astronomer.

What success looks like

  • A scalable ecosystem strategy with the programs, partner solutions, team capabilities, and infrastructure needed to support partners in delivering net new logos, customer expansion, and capabilities in emergent Airflow use cases..
  • Faster partner onboarding, stronger technical capabilities, and higher partner productivity.
  • Increased partner-sourced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline and revenue.
  • More effective ecosystem and product-led acquisition, activation, and conversion.
  • Improved customer adoption, consumption, retention, and expansion.
  • Better GTM decisions and execution through actionable intelligence, scalable operations, and AI-enabled productivity.

A shared GTM growth capability that improves strategic execution and commercial effectiveness across Astronomer.

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in partner ecosystems, alliances, channels, partner programs, or related go-to-market leadership roles, including significant experience in enterprise software, cloud, data, or developer platforms.
  • 5+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional programs, with a record of setting strategy and delivering measurable results.
  • Experience designing or scaling a partner program, including partner segmentation, onboarding, enablement, benefits, incentives, performance standards, and governance.
  • A track record of building partner motions that create measurable business impact, such as sourced or influenced pipeline, revenue, customer adoption, marketplace growth, or successful delivery.
  • Experience translating business strategy into growth programs across acquisition, activation, adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Experience building or using business intelligence, ecosystem analytics, customer insights, or operating tools to identify opportunities and improve execution.
  • Strong understanding of partner go-to-market models, including co-selling, referrals, joint business planning, solution development, and cloud marketplace programs.
  • Experience collaborating across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to deliver programs with shared accountability.
  • A data-driven approach to program design and investment. You can define useful metrics, interpret performance, and adjust resources based on results.
  • Practical experience applying automation or AI to improve GTM decisions, workflows, or team productivity.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across senior internal leaders and external partner executives.
  • Strategic thinking paired with a bias toward action. You can set direction, make sound tradeoffs, and stay close to execution as programs take shape.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace in a high-growth company, and a collaborative, low-ego style that fits a no-handoffs culture.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in an open-source, data, analytics, AI, cloud infrastructure, or developer-tools ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow, data orchestration, or the modern data stack.
  • Experience building partner programs at a SaaS company moving from early ecosystem development to global scale.
  • Experience with cloud partner programs, marketplace listings and private offers, co-sell systems, partner relationship management tools, or channel incentive operations.
  • Experience building partner communities, certification or accreditation programs, solution validation frameworks, or partner-delivered services practices.

#LI-remote

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

item.title: Director, Business Development – Clinical Research Solutions at Vitalief Inc.
item.description:
ABOUT VITALIEF
Vitalief is a specialized clinical research consulting and solutions company focused on helping academic medical centers (AMCs), health systems, hospitals, and research organizations improve clinical research operations and accelerate clinical trial delivery.

Our solutions span Clinical Research Consulting, Workforce and Resourcing Solutions, and Technology-Enabled Managed Services and Outsourcing Solutions. Through our proprietary AI-enabled platform, VELARA, we combine clinical research expertise, technology, and innovative delivery models to help clients streamline operations, improve efficiency, and scale their research programs.

POSITION OVERVIEW
Vitalief is seeking an entrepreneurial, results-driven Director of Business Development – Clinical Research Solutions to drive revenue growth and expand our presence in the academic medical center and health system markets. This individual will generate new business, develop strategic client relationships, and expand existing accounts by positioning Vitalief’s consulting, workforce / resourcing, technology, and managed services solutions.

Initially an individual contributor, the Director will independently manage the full business development lifecycle, from prospecting and relationship development through solution positioning, proposals, negotiations, and contract execution. Working closely with executive leadership and subject matter experts, this individual will identify client needs, develop customized solutions, and help shape Vitalief’s commercial strategy and continued growth, with opportunities for increasing leadership responsibility as the company expands.

WHY JOIN VITALIEF?

  • Innovation-Driven: Be part of the cutting edge of service and technology to dramatically change the way research is conducted at leading clinical research sites for the better.
  • PEOPLE FIRST culture: with opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • Competitive benefits: include 20 PTO days + 9 paid holidays; Company-paid life insurance and short/long-term disability; 401(k) retirement program; Comprehensive healthcare plans.
  • Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus performance-based bonuses and equity incentives.
  • Flexible & Remote-Friendly: Primarily remote with occasional travel (up to 15%) to client sites, industry conferences, and occasional meetings with leadership in Greater Philadelphia.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute strategies to acquire new clients and expand existing accounts.
  • Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities within AMCs, health systems, hospitals, and other clinical research organizations.
  • Build relationships with clinical research executives, research administrators, and other key decision-makers.
  • Independently manage the sales lifecycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution development, presentations, proposals, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Build and maintain a qualified sales pipeline and achieve established revenue targets.

Consultative Solution Selling

  • Understand client challenges and position Vitalief’s solutions to improve clinical research operations, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Sell Vitalief’s three primary service offerings:
  • (1) Clinical Research Consulting: Strategic and operational consulting to improve research infrastructure, processes, and organizational effectiveness.
  • (2) Workforce and Resourcing Solutions: Flexible workforce solutions providing clinical research professionals and specialized expertise.
  • (3) Technology-Enabled Managed Services and Outsourcing: Outsourced clinical research operations leveraging specialized expertise, scalable delivery models, and VELARA AI technology.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts and delivery leaders to develop customized solutions aligned with client needs and budgets.

Account Expansion & Market Development

  • Identify opportunities to expand services within existing client organizations.
  • Develop relationships across departments, service lines, and clinical research functions.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging market opportunities.
  • Represent Vitalief at relevant industry conferences and networking events.
  • Provide market intelligence and strategic feedback to executive leadership.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 7 to 10 years of progressive business development or sales experience, preferably within the clinical research industry.
  • Demonstrated success selling one or more of the following Clinical Research services: Consulting services; Workforce/staffing solutions; Technology, software, or SaaS solutions; Managed services or outsourced clinical research operations.
  • Established relationships and experience developing business within AMCs, health systems, hospitals, or other clinical research organizations.
  • Strong understanding of clinical research operations, research administration, and the challenges facing research organizations.
  • Proven ability to independently generate new business, develop sales pipelines, manage complex sales cycles, and close engagements.
  • Experience with consultative, solution-based selling involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently in a growing organization.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Standing, sitting, walking, visual perception, talking and hearing. Lifting up to 20lbs. Ability to travel up to 15%.

item.title: Principal Engineer, Security at Reddit, Inc.
item.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit’s Platforms & Infrastructure organization builds and operates the compute, storage, data, and platform services behind Reddit. This organization partners across the company to help protect Reddit’s users, products, and systems.

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to provide technical leadership across Reddit’s engineering organization. You’ll work with teams throughout the business to understand how systems and products work, identify security risks, and build practical solutions that fit the needs of the company. This is a broad, hands-on role that combines software and systems engineering, architecture, consulting, and mentorship.

Security at Reddit is a collaborative effort. You’ll help teams make informed tradeoffs, document decisions, and build security into their work without creating unnecessary friction. You’ll also help the Security team grow its impact by sharing knowledge and developing future technical leaders.

What you’ll do:

  • Guide security architecture and technical direction across product, infrastructure, IT, and product engineering teams.
  • Design and deliver security systems and improvements, including work in areas such as access control, cloud and Kubernetes security, identity and access management, observability, and CI/CD.
  • Partner with teams on design reviews and threat modeling, helping them understand risks and choose appropriate mitigations.
  • Lead complex security projects, from planning and technical design through implementation, migration, and operations.
  • Provide practical security guidance on product features, service architecture, and engineering workflows.
  • Improve security processes, documentation, runbooks, dashboards, and incident response practices.
  • Help teams assess and communicate security risks, tradeoffs, and compliance needs.
  • Mentor engineers and security practitioners through reviews, pairing, training, and technical leadership.
  • Build connections across the organization so security work reflects how Reddit’s systems and business operate.

Who you might be:

  • An experienced security or software engineer who has led technical work across a large, complex organization.
  • Skilled at securing systems across multiple domains, such as cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, web applications, identity and access management, or CI/CD.
  • Comfortable writing and reviewing software, and able to understand systems deeply enough to offer useful, specific security guidance.
  • Experienced with architecture reviews, threat modeling, security design, and communicating decisions in clear technical documents.
  • Effective at leading complex projects that involve multiple teams, competing priorities, and real-world constraints.
  • Pragmatic and collaborative: you can explain risk, find workable paths forward, and make sound decisions within an organization’s risk tolerance.
  • A strong mentor who helps others develop security judgment and technical independence.
  • An excellent communicator who can build trust with engineers and cross-functional partners.

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:

$268,700—$401,100 USD

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

item.title: Senior Commercial Account Executive (New York City) at Cloudflare
item.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: NYC

About the Department

Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.

About this Role

Senior AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within this segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Commercial accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.  

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.
  • Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.
  • Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.
  • Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.
  • Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.
  • Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.
  • As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.
  • Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.
  • Position Cloudflare’s platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.
  • Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS
  • Strong B2B discovery skills
  • Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative
  • Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals
  • Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle
  • Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on level and work location.

For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $234,000- 321,000

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

item.title: Sales Engineer II at Axon Spain
item.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Reports into: Dedrone Director of Program Management Position: Dedrone Sales Engineer II Location: Remote About Us Dedrone by Axon is a partnership between Dedrone, the global leader in airspace security, and Axon, a pioneer in public safety technology. Together, we provide cutting-edge solutions to detect, identify, track, and mitigate unauthorized drones, protecting critical assets, events, and environments worldwide. We are seeking a versatile and tech-savvy Sales Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation who enjoys hands-on work, including deploying and installing advanced Dedrone systems across diverse environments, such as rooftops, fields, and event venues. Be part of a transformative partnership between Axon and Dedrone, providing solutions that redefine airspace security. Gain hands-on experience with advanced technologies in a dynamic and impactful role. Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, integrity, and performance. What We Need:

  • System Installation and Deployment:

    • Perform on-site installations of Dedrone by Axon systems, including mounting sensors, cameras, and other components in a variety of environments (e.g., rooftops, open fields, high-security areas).
    • Conduct wiring, cabling, and system integration tasks to ensure proper connectivity and functionality.

  • System Configuration and Testing:

    • Configure Dedrone by Axon systems according to site-specific requirements and customer needs.
    • Perform system testing and troubleshooting to ensure optimal performance before handover to the customer.
    • Provide technical documentation and detailed reporting for installations and troubleshooting efforts.

  • Customer Support:

    • Serve as the on-site technical point of contact for customers during installations and events.
    • Provide training and guidance to customers on system operation and maintenance.
    • Respond promptly to customer inquiries and escalate issues as needed.

  • Maintenance and Upgrades:

    • Conduct routine maintenance and software updates to ensure system reliability.
    • Assist with retrofits and upgrades to existing systems as new Dedrone technologies are introduced.

  • Collaboration:

    • Work closely with internal teams, including engineering, product development, and customer success, to ensure seamless deployment and support of Dedrone by Axon solutions.

  • Safety and Compliance:

    • Adhere to safety guidelines and protocols for working in diverse environments, including rooftops and outdoor installations.
    • Ensure compliance with all site-specific regulations and requirements.

What You Bring:

  • Experience:

    • 2+ years of hands-on technical fieldwork, including system installations or maintenance.
    • Experience working with security systems, sensors, or networked technology preferred.
    • Familiarity with tools and techniques for installation in varied environments (e.g., rooftops, outdoor sites).

  • Skills:

    • Strong technical problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot hardware and software issues.
    • Basic understanding of networking, including IP configuration and wireless communication.
    • Excellent communication skills to interact with customers and cross-functional teams effectively.

  • Knowledge:

    • Understanding counter-drone technologies or security systems is a plus.
    • Familiarity with Axon’s ecosystem of public safety solutions is beneficial.

  • Physical Requirements:

    • Comfortable working at heights, in outdoor environments, and under varying weather conditions.
    • Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 50 pounds.

  • Education:

    • Associate’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience; certifications in networking or security systems are a bonus.

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, Dental, Vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
  • And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? That’s ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

item.title: Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - India at JumpCloud
item.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

 

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer to join the Cloud Platform organization, which owns JumpCloud’s cloud infrastructure, developer experience, and edge and traffic engineering.

This is a hands-on principal role. You’ll write production code and you’ll run what you build. You’ll set the technical direction for the platform that keeps JumpCloud available at 99.99% across regions, and you’ll raise the engineering bar for everyone around you. We want someone who is as comfortable designing and shipping a platform service as they are leading a major incident at 2 a.m.

What You’ll Be Doing :

  • Set the technical direction and multi-year architecture for JumpCloud’s cloud platform across AWS and GCP, covering compute, networking, Kubernetes, data stores, and edge.
  • Write production-grade Go or Python as a regular part of the job: platform services, Kubernetes controllers and operators, internal APIs, CLIs, and automation that removes manual work.
  • Build and evolve our internal developer platform, including golden paths, self-service provisioning, and CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (Argo CD), so product teams can ship safely without filing tickets.
  • Own the design of multi-region architecture, failover automation, and disaster recovery, with RTO and RPO targets we actually test.
  • Operate what you build. Take part in on-call, act as the senior escalation point during major incidents, and turn blameless post-incident reviews into lasting fixes.
  • Define the reliability standards for the platform: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, production readiness reviews, and capacity planning that hold a 99.99% SLA as we grow.
  • Find and remove scalability bottlenecks across services, databases, queues, and network paths before customers feel them.
  • Shape edge and traffic engineering, including ingress, load balancing, DNS, CDN, WAF, and service mesh.
  • Lead our Infrastructure-as-Code architecture in Terraform across multi-account, multi-region environments, with policy-as-code guardrails for security and compliance.
  • Treat cost as a design input. Partner on FinOps, unit economics, and right-sizing so we scale efficiently.
  • Bring AI-assisted engineering (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) into platform work to speed up tooling, runbooks, and incident triage.
  • Write RFCs and architecture decision records, review designs across engineering, and mentor senior and staff engineers.

We’re Looking For :

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps roles running 24⁄7 SaaS systems at scale.
  • Real development depth: You’ve designed, built, and shipped production services in Go, Python, or Java, not just scripts. You’re strong in distributed systems design, APIs, concurrency, and testing.
  • Real operations depth: You’ve carried a pager for business-critical systems, led incident response, and debugged hard problems across the application, OS, network, and cloud layers.
  • Deep AWS expertise (GCP a plus): IAM, VPC design, Transit Gateway, ALB/NLB, Route 53, EKS, and managed data stores.
  • Production Kubernetes at scale: cluster lifecycle, networking, autoscaling, RBAC, operators and controllers, and GitOps with Argo CD.
  • Terraform mastery: module design, state management and refactoring, and multi-account patterns.
  • Observability and reliability: hands-on with Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; you’ve defined SLOs and cut MTTD and MTTR in a measurable way.
  • Principal-level influence: You’ve set direction across multiple teams without direct authority, written design docs that got adopted, and led large migrations to completion.
  • Clear writing and speaking, with engineers and with leadership. You can explain trade-offs in cost, risk, and time.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.

Preferred Qualifications :

  • You’ve built an internal developer platform or developer portal (Backstage or similar) that teams chose to use.
  • Experience with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and proxies (Envoy, HAProxy, NGINX), plus CDN, WAF, and DDoS protection.
  • Experience scaling data layers such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or Kafka, including multi-region or active-active designs.
  • Chaos engineering or regular game days in staging and production.
  • Security depth: secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, External Secrets Operator), DevSecOps, zero-trust networking, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Background in identity, IAM, directory services, or security-focused SaaS.
  • Open-source contributions, published writing, or conference talks on platform or reliability topics.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

 

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at [email protected] with the subject line “Scam Notice”
